de chos can/ blo'i mtshan nyid min par thal/ blo dang rnam grangs pa yin pa'i phyir te/ chos mchog las/ shes pa dang blo dang rtogs pa zhes bya ba ni rnam grangs yin la zhes so/ /khyab pa yod/ blo dang de grub ma grub kyi khyad par mi 'thad pas/ rtags dang rtags can du mi rung ba'i phyir te/ de nyid du sgra tha dad pas don tha dad pa'am grub pa dang ma grub par 'gyur ba ni mi 'thad do zhes dang / gang zhig rtogs pa'i dus nyid na gang rtogs pa de dag ni rtags dang rtags can ma yin te zhes so/ /gnyis pa rang lugs bzhag pa ni/ bem po'i rigs mi mthun gang zhig spyod byar skyes pa ste/ rnam nges las rnam shes bem po'i rang bzhin las/ bzlog par rab tu skye ba ste/ zhes dang / rnam 'grel du/ myong bya nyid phyir sems yin no/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa dbye ba la gnyis gzhan lugs dgag pa ni/ snga rabs pa rnams tshad ma gnyis/ tshan min lnga ste bdun no/ /de dag gi the tshom las gzhan pa'i blo drug gi spyi rigs ngo bo gcig yin te/ sgra mi rtag pa sgyu mar nges pa ste de sgra mi rtag pa la rjes dpag sgyu ma la yid dpyod/ mi rtag pa la bcad shes/ sgra don la log shes/ rang la mngon sum/ rig pa'i skad cig la ltos te snang la ma nges pa'o zhes pa mi 'thad de/ mi rtag pa la tshad ma min na sgra mi rtag pa la rjes dpag tu mi 'thad la/ sgyu ma la the tshom yin pas yid dpyod kyi mtshan nyid dang 'gal zhing / tshad min sngar 'byed pa'ang mi 'thad par 'og nas ston to/ /kha cig yul la ma zhugs pa 'jug bzhin pa zhugs zin pa gsum du'ang dbyer yod la/ yul can gyi sgo nas rang rig du 'du gsung ba'ang mi 'thad de/ yul de la ma zhugs na de rtogs pa min pas/ de la blor mi 'thad pa'i phyir dang / blo kun yul can gyi sgo nas mngon sum du 'du bar thal ba'i phyir ro/ /yang rang rig la yul med ces pa'ang mi 'thad de/ tshad ma yin pa'i phyir te/

chos mchog las/ gang yul dang ldan pa ma yin pa de ni tshad ma ma yin te/ dper na nam mkha'i ut+pal bzhin no zhes so/ /gnyis pa rang lugs bzhag pa la/ gang zag byed las/ ngo bo/ 'jug tshul gyi sgo nas dbye ba bzhi'i dang po la/ dbye na 'phags pa dang 'phags pa ma yin pa'i blo gnyis so/ /gnyis pa la rtog pa rtog med gnyis las/ dang po la gsum ste/ mtshan nyid gtan la dbab/ de'i dbye ba bstan/ khyad par byed chos bshad pa'o/ /dang po la dgag gzhag gnyis las/ dang po ni/ phya pas/ don spyi 'dzin pa zhes pa 'dzin pa'i blos ma nges la/ gtsang nag sgra don 'dzin pa zhes pa rnal 'byor pa'i mngon sum gyis ma nges te/ chos mchog tu/ rnal 'byor pa'i shes pa la sgra don du ma snang du zin kyang rnam par rtog pa med pa nyid de zhes so/ /phal cher brjod bya rjod byed 'drer rung 'dzin pa zhes pa ni rtogs pas ma nges te/ brjod par bya byed 'dre ba mi srid pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ brjod bya rjod byed 'dre rung bar snang bas sgra don 'dzin pa'i zhen pa ste/ rnam nges las/ rtog pa ni brjod pa dang 'dres rung bar snang ba'i shes pa ste zhes so/ /'o na gzugs med na sgra med pas rtogs pa med par 'gyur zhe na skyon med de/ sgra spyi 'dzin pas so/ /gnyis pa de'i dbye ba bstan pa la/ gang zag ngo bo/ yul/ byed pa'i sgo nas dbye ba bzhi'i dang po la/ sgra don 'dres par snang ba brda la byang ba'i rtog pa dang / 'dres par mi snang yang 'drar rung bar snang ba byas pa sogs la ma byang ba'i rtog pa gnyis so/ /gnyis pa la tshad ma tshad min nam ma 'khrul ba dang 'khrul pa gnyis te/ dang po ni rjes dpag gnyis pa ni de las gzhan pa'o/ /gsum pa la/ don spyi/ sgra spyi/ de gnyis ka 'dzin pa gsum mam/ rigs sogs/ 'brel pa/ sgra don 'dzin pa gsum du blo gros gnyis kyis bshad pa ltar ram/ don gyi ngo bo dang khyad par la rtog pa gnyis so/

/bzhi pa la/ nges pa dang the tshom gnyis las dang po la gnyis kyi mtshan nyid ni/ mtha' gcig tu nges pa'i rtog pa ste/ chos mchog tu/ the tshom las ldog pa ni nges pa yin te/ zhes dang / nges pa ni gtan la phebs pa ste zhes so/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ chos mchog tu/ nges pa yang don 'ga' zhig ni so sor nges pa'i rang gi ngo bor nges par byed de zhes dang / 'ga' zhig ni nges pa na de dang de ma yin pa'i ngo bor nges par byed de zhes pa ltar/ yang dag pa dang phyin ci log tu nges pa gnyis las/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ zhen yul phyin ci ma log par mtha' gcig tu nges pa ste/ dbye na/ rjes dpag dang / bcad shes gnyis so/ /gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni phyin ci log tu mtha' gcig tu 'dzin pa'i rtog pa'o/ /dbye na mi rtag pa las rtag pa dang / snga phyi gcig tu dang / mtshan mo zla zer gyi gos dkar po la ser po dang / mgal me 'khor lor nges pa lta bu/ ngo bo/ dus/ rnam pa/ yul la phyin ci log tu nges pa'o/ /gnyis pa the tshom la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po la dgag pa ni kha cig mtha' gzhan du dogs pa ni gang zag gis ma nges la/ gtsang nag pas/ yul la rtse gnyis su 'jug pa zhes pa ni dngos med la the tshom gyi blo ma nges so/ /gnyis pa bzhag pa ni/ mtha' gcig tu ma nges pa'i zhen pa'i rtog pa ste/ shākya blor/ the tshom yang gnyis ka'i cha la brten pa yin pas shes so/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ mngon du rgyu dang bag la nyal gnyis so/ cha mnyam pa dang shas cher 'dzin pa'i the tshom gnyis so/ /bag la nyal la rtags la ltos ma ltos gnyis te/ ma nges pa'i rtags la brten pa dang / yid dpyod lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa khyad par byed chos bshad pa la brjod bya brjod byed/ brda sbyor tshul/ don rtogs tshul lo/ /dang po la gnyis kyi brjod bya la dgag pa ni/ kha cig don rang mtshan sgra'i dngos kyi brjod bya yin no zhes pa mi 'thad de/ dngos su brda sbyar bar mi nus pa'i phyir te/

rnam 'grel du/ bka' dang mi nus 'bras med phyir/ /dngos po la min zhes so/ /rang mtshan brjod bya gtan ma yin du chu mig pas 'dod pa'ang mi 'thad de/ rtog pa'i yul ma yin par thal ba'i phyir ro/ /des na rtog yul du rung ba thams cad sgra brjod bya yin la/ dngos kyi brjod bya ni rtog pa'i dngos yul kun yin no/ /gnyis pa rang lugs bzhag pa la mtshan nyid ni/ brjod byed las go bya ste/ rgyan las sgra gang zhig brjod pa na/ /rtogs pa'i don gang yin pa de/ sgra yi brjod bya yin zhes so/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ dngos dang / zhen pa'i brjod bya gnyis te/ gzhan sel dang / rang mtshan no/ /de'ang rnam 'grel las/ de dngos sgro btags rtogs pa yis/ /gzhan las ldog pa rtogs phyir yang zhes dang / gtan tshigs thigs pa'i 'grel par/ skyes bus zhen par byed pa'i ngor sgra'i don nyid du de rnam par bzhag par bya'o zhes so/ /dang po la dbye na/ dgag pa dang sgrub pa/ chos dang chos can/ tha dad dang tha dad min pa/ bsgrub bya sgrub byed/ spyi dang gzhi mthun/ mtshan nyid dang mtshon bya la sogs pa du mar dbyer yod do/ /gnyis pa rjod byed la dgag pa ni/ ral gri/ rjod byed mtshan nyid pa sgra spyi'o zhes dang / 'u yug pa/ sgra gang rtogs pa brjod bya go byed kyi thabs su gyur pa zhes pa ni/ nang gi rjod byed la ma khyab bo/ gnyis pa bzhag pa la mtshan nyid ni/ brjod bya go byed de/ rnam 'grel du/ yig ge don med can 'gyur zhing / zhes pa'i shugs kyis grub la/ 'dis ni chu mig pa sogs kyi yi ge rjod byed du 'dod pa'ang bkag go /gnyis pa dbye ba la/ nang dang sgra'i rjod byed gnyis kyi dang po ni/ ngo shes pa'i rtog pa ste/ rnam 'grel du/ de las gzhan dang bral ba yi/ /yul can gyi ni sgra rnams kyis/ /lhan cig sbyar nas ngo shes byed/ /ces dang / rtog ge'i skad las/ nang gi brjod pa'i rnam pa ni rtog pa ste/

dper na rnam par shes pa dang ldan pa'i skyes bu'i 'di bum pa'o zhes pa'i rtog pa bzhin no/ /byis pa dang lkugs pa dang / dud 'gro la sogs pa rnams kyi nang gi brjod pa'i rnam pa lhur byed pa'i ngo bo rtogs zhes so/ /gnyis pa la rgyu ni/ chos mchog tu/ sgra'i dngos kyi rgyu ni gnas dang byed pa phrad pa yin la de'i rgyu ni rjod par 'dod pa/ de'i rgyu bstan par sems pa yin no zhes pa ltar ro/ /mtshan nyid ni yi ge'i bkod pa la brten nas btags pa'i rjod byed kyi sgra'o/ /dbye ba la/ ngo bo/ brda'i sgo nas dbye ba gnyis kyi dang po la ming tshig gnyis las/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid ni/ don gyi ngo bo rjod byed kyi sgra ste/ rgyan du/ gang zhig cha rnams 'dus pa yis/ /don gyi ngo bo rjod byed la/ /rnam cha mang ngam nyung gyur kyang / /de ni ming zhes rab tu brjod/ /ces so/ /gnyis pa dbye na gnyis las/ dngos ming la mtshan nyid ni/ 'dod rgyal thog mar sbyor bas rang gi brjod bya la grags pas mi 'khrul bar grub pa'i ming ste/ rnam 'grel du/ ji ltar grags las grub gang yin/ /dngos dang zhes so/ /dbye na/ lhas byin dang shing zhes pa lta na ming dang rigs kyi sgra gnyis so/ /gnyis pa btags pa ming la mtshan nyid ni/ dngos ming la brten na brda byas pa'i rgyu mtshan gyi ming ste/ rnam 'grel du/ de dang mtshungs pa'i phyir/ gang la de skad brjod phal pa/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa dbye na 'brel pa dang / sman khra rkang zhes pa lta bu 'dra ba rgyu mtshan du byas pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ rgyu la 'bras bus 'bras bu la rgyu ya gyal tshogs pa/ tshogs pa la ya gyal gyi ming gis btags pa'o/ /dper na sgrub ngag la rjes dpag nyi 'od la nyi ma/ ras yug gi phyogs gcig tshig pa la ras yug tshig rnga'i sgra zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa tshig la/ mtshan nyid ni/ don gyi khyad par ston pa'i rjod byed kyi sgra ste/

rgyan du/ gal te ming gnyis 'dus pa'am/ /'on te mang po 'dus kyang rung / /de dag khyad par brjod byed na/ /tshig ces rab tu brjod pa ste/ /zhes so/ /dbye na bcu ste 'bras bu mang po dang tshig sdud dang / khyad par dag dang yan lag dang / gzhi dang gzhi gcig bsdu ba dang / gzhi mthun pa dang de skyes bu/ /zlas dbye ba dang phyogs tsam mo/ /zhes pa ltar de dgos pa chung bas 'dir ma bshad do/ /gnyis pa brda'i sgo nas dbye ba la/ dbye ba dngos dang / de'i mu brtsi ba gnyis so/ /dang po la/ chos dang chos can brjod pa gnyis las/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni brjod bya'i khyad par gzhan spong ba'i tshul gyis brjod bya go byed kyi sgra ste/ khyad par gzhi spong ba dang zhes so/ /dbye na bum pa nyid ces pa lta bu/ de'i rigs brjod pa dang / bum pa'i mi rtag pa nyid ces pa lta bu de'i chos brjod yin yang de'i rigs brjod pa min pa gnyis so/ /gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni/ brjod bya'i khyad par gzhan mi spangs pa'i tshul gyi brjod bya go byed kyi sgra ste/ rnam 'grel du/ mi spong ba dag ces so/ /khyad par gzhan mi spong ba ni/ khyad par gzhan blo yul du 'phen mi 'phen no/ /dbye na bum pa zhes pa lta bu/ rang gi tshogs pa can la ltos nas tshogs pa brjod pa dang / tshogs brjod ma yin pa nam mkha'i rang bzhin zhes pa lta bu gnyis so/ /gnyis pa de'i mu brtsi ba ni/ rigs brjod la tshogs brjod ma yin pa bde zhes pa lta bu ste/ bde ba la yan lag gi cha med pa'i phyir ro/ /tshogs brjod yin la rigs brjod ma yin pa ni 'bigs byed gangs can ri rab ces pa lta bu ste/ de'i rigs can gyi tshogs pa gzhan med pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis ka min pa ni bum pa zhes pa lta bu ste/ tshogs pa gzhan gser bum sogs la ltos nas rigs brjod dang / rang gi tshogs pa can gzugs dri ro reg bya bzhi la ltos te/ tshogs brjod du 'gyur bas so/

/gnyis pa brda sbyor ba'i tshul la/ spyir tha snyad 'dogs pa'i tshul ni/ rtog pa la snang ba'i sgra don la phyi rol don du zhen nas de dang de min gnyis su phye nas de min bcad pa'i tshul gyis brda sbyor te/ rnam 'grel du/ gcig rtogs shes bya'i shes pa ni/ gcig la gnas pa'i rtogs pa po/ de dang de min rgyu don rnams/ /bdag nyid rnam par 'byed par byed/ /blo de la ni yod pa'i dngos/ /blo rgyu nyid du snang ba dang / /rgyu min ngo bo bral ba dang / /ngo bo gcig 'drar bdag nyid kyis/ /tha dad par ni shes 'gyur bas/ tha dad pa la skad sbyor te/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa dgag sgrub kyi tha snyad sbyor tshul la dbye ba dang / bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis kyi sgrub pa'i sgo nas sbyor tshul la/ 'bras bu dang / rgyu'i sgo nas brda sbyor tshul gnyis kyi dang po la/ tshogs pa dang / rgyu dang / gnas skabs khyad par can gyi sgra gsum gyi dang po la/ tshogs pa du ma dang / gcig la 'jug pa gnyis te/ de dag kyang 'bras bu gcig byed pa'i sgo nas brdar byas pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgyun gcig la brten nas sgra gcig brdar byas pa mi zhes pa lta bu ste/ byis pa dang gzhon nu sogs gnas skabs tha dad pa'i rgyun gcig brjod pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni/ gnas skabs khyad par can du gyur pa'i sgo nas gcig pa'i tshig sbyar ba ste/ dper na rdul phran so so'am bsdus pa mig shes kyi yul du gyur pa na gtan du yod sems sam/ rang gi yul du gzhan 'byung ba'i gegs byed par gyur pa la thogs bcas zhes pa'i gcig gi tshig brdar byas pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa rgyu'i sgo nas brda sbyar ba ni/ ma khra mo dang ser skya'i bu snga phyi dag la ba khra mo'i bu zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa dgag pa'i sgo nas sbyor tshul la gnyis las/ 'bras bu dgag pa'i sgo nas sbyor tshul ni/ 'bras bu bde ba dang gtsang ba sogs bkag pa'i sgo nas zag bcas mi gtsang ba dang duḥkha ba zhes dang /

sgra mig gi gzung bya min zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa rgyu bkag pa'i sgo nas sbyor ba ni/ gzhan byed pa po bdag gis bdag gir byas pa bdag rgyu yin par 'dod pa bkag nas sgra sbyor ba dngos po 'di ni bdag po med pa zhes pa lta bu'o/ /bsdu ba ni/ de ltar na sgra sbyor ba thams cad dgag sgrub gnyis kyi sgo nas sbyor bas tha snyad thams cad dgag sgrub kyi tha snyad gnyis las mi 'da' ste/ rnam 'grel du/ dgag dang sgrub pa ma gtogs par/ /sgra las byung ba'i tha snyad gzhan/ /yod min zhes so/ /gsum pa don rtogs tshul ni/ rjod byed kyi sgra las brda dang tha snyad kyi dus kyi don gcig tu 'khrul nas brda ji lta ba bzhin du tha snyad kyi dus su yang don go ste/ rnam 'grel du/ de las de rtogs gyur pa'i blo/ 'khrul pas dngos po gcig ltar rtogs/ zhes so/ /de yang rjod byed kyi sgra thams cad kyis rjes 'gro dngos dang ldog pa shugs kyis brjod pas rtog pas kyang de ltar dngos shugs la go ste/ shākya blor/ sgras rjes su 'gro ba dang ldog pa brjod par bya ba yin te/ rjes su 'gro ba ni dngos su brjod pa dang / ldog pa ni shugs kyis brjod par bya'o zhes dang / sgras ni ji ltar rnam par phye ba'i tha dad pa gang yin pa de gcig kho na brjod de/ de rtogs pa nyid rjes su 'gro ba rtogs pa yin no/ gzhan ldog pa shugs kyis grub pa gang yin te de ltar rjes su 'gro ba dang ldog pa rtogs pas sgra don ldan pa yin no zhes so/ /gnyis pa rtogs med la gnyis las/ gzhan lugs dgag pa ni/ kha cig don spyi mi 'dzin pa la 'dod pa ni dngos med kyi ma nges so/ /gnyis pa rang lugs ni/ rang yul gsal bar snang ba'i blo ste/ chos mchog tu/ gsal bar snang ba yin pa'i phyir rnam par rtog pa med par grub pa yin la zhes dang / rtog pa'i rnam par shes pa ni gsal bar snang ba ma yin no zhes so/

/dbye na 'khrul ma 'khrul gnyis las/ dang po la dgag pa ni/ bsod rgyal/ blo gang snang yul la ltos te 'drer rung 'dzin pa dang mi slu bas stong pa zhes pa ni/ dbang shes dang yid shes rtog med 'khrul pa la ma khyab bo/ /gnyis pa rang lugs ni/ phyin ci log tu gsal bar snang ba'i rig pa'o/ /dbye na dbang shes dang yid shes 'khrul pa gnyis te/ rnam nges su/ nye bar bslad pa bslu ba'i phyir/ /mngon sum ltar snang zhes dang / de'i 'grel par/ 'dis ni yid kyis rnam par bslad pa yang bshad pa yin no zhes sogs/ dang po la dbye na/ zla ba gnyis 'dzin dang mgal me la 'khor lo dang / dung ser 'dzin/ grur zhugs pa las shing sogs 'gro bar snang ba lta bu yul/ don byed pa'i rang bzhin/ rnam pa/ bya ba la 'khrul pa la sogs pa'o/ /gnyis pa la rmi lam gsal snang dang / zad par zil gnon la sogs pa bsgom byung min pa dang / sgom byung gi gsal snang gnyis yod do/ /rtog med ma 'khrul ba ni mngon sum ste 'og tu 'chad do/ /gsum pa ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/ 'khrul ma 'khrul gnyis las/ dang po la gnyis las/ mtshan nyid ni/ phyin ci log tu 'dzin pa'i blo ste/ rnam 'grel gyi rang 'grel du/ 'khrul pa'i mtshan nyid ni phyin ci log tu snang ba yin no zhes so/ /gnyis pa dbye na rtog pa dang / rtog med 'khrul pa gnyis so/ /gnyis pa ni/ tshad ma yin pas 'og nas 'chad do/ /gsum pa 'jug tshul gyi sgo nas dbye ba la/ snang ba dang / sel bas 'jug pa'i blo gnyis las/ dang po la gnyis las/ mtshan nyid la dgag pa ni/ chu mig pas/ myong stobs kyis yul du byed pa zhes pa ni kun mkhyen gyi blo gzhan gyi bde sdug la sgrub 'jug ma yin par thal zhing / 'u yug pa blo gang yul de'i rnam pa snang nas 'dzin pa zhes pa ni blos ma nges so/ /gnyis pa bzhag pa ni/ char ma phye bar gsal bar snang ba'i blo ste/ rnam 'grel du/ don gyi rang gi ngo bo gcig

/bdag nyid mngon sum yin pa la/ tshad ma rnams kyi brtag bya gang / ma mthong cha gzhan cig yod/ ces so/ /gnyis pa dbye ba la gnyis las/ snang ba 'khrul pa la mtshan nyid ni/ char ma phye bar phyin ci log tu gsal bar snang ba'i shes pa'o/ /dbye na rtog med 'khrul pa ltar gnyis so/ /gnyis pa snang ba ma 'khrul ba la mtshan nyid ni/ char ma phye ba'i sgo nas phyin ci ma log par gsal bar snang ba'i shes pa'o/ /dbye na don rig mngon sum dang rang rig go /gnyis pa rtogs bya yul la mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ mu brtsi ba gsum gyi dang po la gnyis las/ dgag pa ni/ chos gang zhig gi rnam pa blo la shar ba la brten nas nges par bya ba zhes pa ni rtog med kyis ma nges te rtog pa min pas nges byed min pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa bzhag pa ni/ blos rig par bya ba'o/ /gnyis pa dbye ba la snang yul/ zhen yul/ 'jug yul/ gzung yul bzhi las dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ snang nas rig bya'o/ /dbye na rtog med ma 'khrul ba dang rtog pa'i snang yul gnyis so/ /dang po la bem rig gnyis dang / gnyis pa la dgag sgrub gnyis so/ /gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni/ zhes rtogs par bya ba ste/ shes bya thams cad do/ /gnyis pa dbye ba la rtogs tshul dang / don byed mi byed kyi sgo nas dbye ba la gnyis las dang po ni rnam 'grel du/ de ni rang gzhan ngo bo yis/ /rtog phyir gzhal bya gnyis su bzhed/ /ces pa ltar rang spyi gnyis las dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis so/ /dang po la dgag pa ni/ kha cig 'dzin pa la don byed nus shing thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam par snang du rung ba'o zhe na/ phyin ci ma log pa'i yongs grub rang mtshan min par thal ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa bzhag pa ni/ don dam par don byed pa ste/ rnam 'grel du/ don dam don byed nus pa gang / /de 'dir don dam yod pa yin/ /zhes so/ /dbye na bem rig gnyis so/ /gnyis pa spyi mtshan la mtshan nyid ni/

don dam du don mi byed pa'i chos te/ de nyid du/ gzhan ni kun rdzob yin pa ste zhes so/ /dbye na spyi bye brag gnyis las spyi la rigs kyi spyi/ tshogs spyi/ don spyi/ bsdu ba'i spyi/ rnam rtog gi spyi ste lnga'i dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis kyi dang po la dgag pa ni/ chu mig pas/ rang gi bye brag la ltos pa'i rigs mi mthun las log pa zhes pa ni spyis ma nges te/ rang gi bye brag mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa bzhag pa ni/ rang gi khyab bya'i gsal ba la thun mong bar khyab pa'i rigs ldog ste/ rnam 'grel du/ don gyi ngo bo nyid kyi spyi/ /kun la ngo bo mtshungs phyir dang / /de ldog pa la brten phyir ro/ /zhes so/ /dbye na dngos po dang / dngos po min pa la brten pa gnyis so/ /gnyis pa tshogs spyi la mtshan nyid ni/ chos du ma 'dus pa'i chos can gang zhig rang gi tshogs pa can la khyab byed thun mong bar grub pa ste/ rtog ge'i skad du/ skad cig ma du ma tshogs pa'i spyi ni zhes dang / rgyal dbang blor/ rdul phra rab rnams kyang 'dus pa'i gnas skabs kho na phan tshun phan btags pa shes pa'i rgyu rnams te zhes so/ /gnyis pa dbye na tshogs pa gcig dang du ma'o/ /gsum pa don spyi ni/ gsal ba du ma la gcig tu zhen pa'i rtog pa'i rnam pa ste/ rnam 'grel du/ dngos rnams ngo bo 'ga' zhig gis/ /tha dad min pa lta bur snang / de la bsam pa'i dbang gis ni/ /spyi yod par ni rab tu bsgrags/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa bsdu ba'i spyi ni/ gzhi mthun pa'i spyi ste/ dper na bum pa yang yin la dngos po yang yin zhes pa lta bu ste/ dbye na dang po/ dngos med gnyis ka la brten pa gsum mo/ /lnga pa rnam rtag gi spyi ni/ phyogs gnyis gang rung gi spyi ste/ dper na gong bu 'ga' zhig ba lang ba men gang rung du the tshom za zhing / ba lang ba men gang rung yin pa na ba lang ba men gang rung gi spyi lta bu the tshom rnam rtagaṃ gi spyi ste/

gang rung du nges na de'i spyi mi srid de/ rnam par brtags pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro zhes rnam nges las so/ /gnyis pa bye brag la mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ rang gi spyi la ltos nas bzhag pa'i khyad par ldog pa gnyis tshogs pa ste/ rnam 'grel du/ 'di ltar ldog pa'i ngo bo can/ /des na tha dad med lta bur/ /de nyid gzhan las ldog par yang snang ste zhes so/ /dbye na rigs tshogs pa/ bsdu ba/ rnam brtag gi bye brag bzhi'am/ dngos po/ dngos po min pa la brten pa gnyis so/ /gnyis pa don byed mi byed kyi sgo nas dbye na dngos po dngos med gnyis las dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ don byed pa ste/ rigs thigs su/ dngos po'i mtshan nyid don byed nus pa kho na yin pa'i phyir zhes so/ /dbye ba ngo bo dang byed pa'i sgo nas dbye ba gnyis las dang po la dngos gcig dang tha dad gnyis las dang po'i mtshan nyid ni/ don byed nus bdag gcig pa ste/ dbye na bum pa lta bu tha mi dad pa dang / tha dad las byas mi rtag lta bu khyab mnyam pa dang / bum pa dang mi rtag pa lta bu khyab mi mnyam pa gnyis so/ /gnyis pa mtshan nyid ni don byed pa gang ngo bo tha dad pa'o/ /dbye na tsha grang lta bu 'gal ba/ me du ba lta bu 'gal zhing 'brel pa/ ka bum lta bu 'gal 'brel gnyis ka min pa ste gsum mo/ /byed pa'i sgo nas dbye na bem rig gnyis las/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ thogs bcas gang rig pa'i rigs mi mthun no/ dbye na phyi'i yul lnga nang gi dbang po lnga'o/ /rig pa bshad zin to// ༈ /gnyis pa dngos med la mtshan nyid ni/ don byed pas stong pa ste/ rnam 'grel du/ de mi rung phyir rang bzhin mod/ de ni dngos med mtshan nyid yin/ /zhes so/ /dbye ba chos chos can gnyis so/ /gsum pa 'jug yul la gnyis las/ mtshan nyid la dgag pa ni/ kha cig tshad ma gtogs bya zhes pa ni/ bum 'dzin mngon sum gyi gzung don bum pa'i skad cig chos can/

bum 'dzin mngon sum gyis rtogs bya yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ chos mchog tu/ thob par bya ba yang 'dir 'jug pa'i yul nyid la nges par brtag par bya ba yin la/ 'jug pa'i yul yang nges pa nyid yin no zhes dang / mngon sum gyis gzung ba'i don ni thob par rung ba ma yin te/ skad cig ma nyid yin pa'i phyir ro zhes so/ /kha cig tshad mas gzhal ba las blang dor byar rung zhes pa'ang mi 'thad de dor bya yin na spang bya yin pas thob byar 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa bzhag pa ni/ tshad mas gzhal ba ltar yongs su bcad nas thob par byar rung ste/ de ni blang dor 'bras can pas/ /skyes bu thams cad 'jug pa yin/ /zhes dang / rang gi mtshan nyid gcig gzhal bya/ /zhes rnam 'grel dang / chos mchog tu/ yongs su bcad pa'i don nyid 'jug pa'i yul yin gyi zhes so/ /dbye na mngon gyur lkog gyur gnyis sam/ gnas skabs mthar thug gi 'jug yul gnyis so/ bzhi pa gzung yul la dgag bzhag gnyis so/ /dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba dgag pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ snga rabs pa dag 'dzin pa la snang rung zhes pa ni mi 'thad de/ rtog med 'khrul pa chos can/ skra shad zla gnyis kyang gzung yul gnyis so/ /skra zla gnyis 'dzin pa la snang du rung ba'i phyir te/ rnam 'grel du/ 'khrul pa'i shes pa can rnams kyis/ /zla gnyis med bzhin tha dad mthong / /zhes so/ /'dod par mi nus te/ chos mchog tu/ rab rib la sogs pas dbang po nyams pa las skyes pa ni phyin ci log gi rnam pa bzhag pa'i phyir bskyed par byed pa yin yang gzung ba ma yin te/ zla ba gnyis kyi shes pa la zla ba gcig gis rang gi rnam pa ma bzhag pa'i phyir ro/ /'dis ni gzung don dang dmigs rkyen gyi khyad par yang bshad pa yin no/ /'dzin pa'i rnam pa yang 'dzin pa'i gzung yul du thal ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa dbye ba dgag pa ni/ snga rabs pa phal che ba bzung yul rang mtshan/

don spyi/ dngos med gsal snang ngo / dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ 'dzin pa la thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam par snang zhing don byed pa ste/ dbye na/ yul dang dbang po sems sems byung thad do zhe na/ dmigs rkyen zla ba gcig kyang zla ba gnyis 'dzin dbang shes kyi yul du thal zhing / dbang po dang sems sems byung tha mal gyi gzhan rig mngon sum gyi yul du thal ba'i phyir ro/ /'dod mi nus te/ rnam 'grel du/ dbang po'i nus sogs la/ dbang po'i blo ni med pa'i phyir/ /zhes dang / dpe ni dus mtshungs rnam par shes/ /gzhan gyis myong ba bstan pa yin/ /zhes so/ /gzung yul don spyi la mtshan nyid ni/ 'dzin pa la thun mong gi rnam par snang zhing don byed pas stong pa ste/ rang gzhan shes bya la srid pa dang mi srid pa'i don spyi'o zhes pa'ang mi 'thad de/ de dag gzung yul min par thal/ rang 'dzin bskyed byed min pa'i phyir/ khyab pa yod/ rnam 'grel las/ gzung ba bskyed byed las gzhan min/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa med gsal la mtshan nyid ni/ 'dzin pa la thun mong min pa'i rnam par snang zhing don byed pas stong pa ste/ dbye na dbang yid rtog med 'khrul pa'i gzung yul te/ zla gnyis dang rmi lam gyi rta glang gi rnam pa lta bu'o zhes pa mi 'thad de/ rnam pa de dag rang 'dzin dang lhan cig dmigs nges ma yin par thal/ shes pa/ brtan yod/ rang mtshan min par thal te/ 'dod par mi nus/ rnam 'grel du/ de phyir shes nus snang ba yi/ don ni shes las gzhan min pa/ /bzlog par rab tu dka' ba nyid/ /ces dang / rung yul gnas pas mi shes pa/ /rang nyid shes phyir de shes yin/ /zhes dang / gal te spyi ni shes ngo bo'i/ /de nyid yin na thal bar 'gyur/ /de ltar 'dod phyir skyon yod min/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa rang lugs bzhag pa la gsum las/ mtshan nyid ni/ 'dzin pa ma 'khrul ba rang 'dra'i rnam pa gtod byed de/ rnam 'grel du/ shes pa rnam pa 'jog nus pa'i/

/rgyu nyid la ni bzung bar shes/ /zhes so/ /dbye ba la dbang po dang / yid kyi mngon sum gyi gzung don nam/ bem gnyis so/ /gsum pa rnam gzhag la gsum las/ dgag pa ni/ bye brag smra ba rdul phra rab gzung don du 'dod de/ rtog ge'i skad du/ rtsom par byed pa rdul phra rab de rnams ni bye brag tu smra ba rnams kyi lta ba la dngos su mngon sum gyi spyod yul yin no zhes so/ /mi 'thad de/ rang 'dzin gyi yul ma yin pa'i phyir te/ dmigs pa rtag tu dbang po rnam pa rig pa'i rgyu/ /phra rab rdul dag yin mod kyi/ /de mi snang phyir de yul ni/ /rdul phran ma yin dbang po bzhin/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa bzhag pa ni/ phyi'i don dpyod pa'i skabs su slob dpon yang mdo sde pa dang 'dra bar rags pas gzung don du bzhed cing / rnam rig pa'i lugs la brten pa na bag chags kyi dbang gis 'byung ba'i snang ba la 'jog pa yin te/ nyi shu par/ rang gi sa bon gang las su/ /rnam rig snang ba gang byung ba/ /de dang de yi skye mched ni/ rnam pa gnyis su thub pas gsungs/ /zhes dang / dmigs brtag tu/ nang las shes bya'i ngo bo ni/ /don yin zhes dang / chos mchog gis/ rnam rig tsam du smra ba la ni slob dpon bag chags brtan pa dang mi brtan pa dag gis rnam par 'jog pa mthong la/ 'dir ni don med na mi 'byung ba las zhes de lta bu la sogs pa gsungs pas na/ phyi rol gyi don gyi tshul nyid bshad pa yin no zhes so/ /rags pa ni rdul phran rang 'dzin bskyed pa'i rkyen du gyur pa rnams phan tshun thag nye bar gyur pa ste/ kun las btus su/ gcig min don gyis bskyed bya'i phyir/ /rang don spyi yi spyod yul can/ /zhes dang / de'i 'grel par rang gi rgyu dang rkyen rnams las rdul phra rab phan tshun thag nye ba'i gnas skabs thob pa kho nar gyur pa so sor rnam par shes pa bskyed par nus pa rnams skye ba ni bsags pa'i sgras brjod de bsags pa bsdus pa'i rnam grangs can 'di rnams yang dag par skye ba'o zhes dang /

dbang po'i shes pa'i yul ni rdul phra rab ces bya ba gcig min gyi dngos po ste zhes so/ /gsum pa 'gal ba spang ba ni/ rnam 'grel du/ dbang yul de phyir rdul phran min zhes pa dang 'gal zhe na/ de ni ma tshogs dang khyad med kyi rdul phra rab min pa la dgongs la/ 'dir ni 'dus pa'i rdul phra rab yul yin pa la dgongs pas mi 'gal lo/ /gal te shākya blo las/ rdul phra rab shin tu nye bar gnas pa/ yul ma chad par gnas pa/ rdul phra rab gzhan gyis bskor ba mngon sum gyi yul yin no/ /rdul phra rab de dag kyang phan tshun 'dres pa ma yin te zhes pa dang 'gal zhe na/ de'ang snga ma ltar bsags pa'i rdul phran la dgongs pa ste/ de lta ma yin na de nyid du/ rdul phra rab kyi rnam pa can gyi shes pa ni tshu rol mthong ba 'ga' zhig kyang yang dag par rig pa ma yin no/ /de bas na rdul phra rab mngon sum gyi yul ma yin zhing rjes su dpag pa'i yang ma yin te/ de la 'bras bu rnam par shes pa ldog pa'i rtags las brtag par bya ba yin no zhes so/ /gsum pa mu brtsi ba ni/ yul bzhi po de dag las/ zhes yul yin la 'jug yul min pa tshad min blo'i yul/ 'jug yul yin la min pa mngon sum gyi gzhal bya gnyis ka yin pa rjes dpag gi 'jug yul/ gnyis pa min pa gzung don gyi skad cig te/ 'jug yul ni rgyud la 'jog pas so/ /snang yul dang zhen yul yang snga ma ltar bzhi ste/ mu dang por rang rig gi yul/ mu gnyis pa rjes dpag gi 'jug yul/ gsum pa don spyi/ bzhi pa mngon sum gyi 'jug yul lo/ /zhen yul dang gzung yul la'ang mu bzhi ste/ dang po rtog yul gyi rang mtshan/ gnyis pa mngon sum gyi gzung don/ gsum pa mi srid cing / bzhi pa rang rig mngon sum gyi yul te/ shākya blo mig la sogs pa'i rnam par shes pa rnams kyi rang rig pa nyid gnyis med pa yin te zhes so/ /'jug yul dang snang yul la'ang bzhi ste/

dang po rjes dpag gi 'jug yul/ gnyis pa rjes dpag gi snang yul/ gsum pa rnal 'byor mngon sum gyi dngos po'i rgyun/ bzhi pa ni rtog pa'i zhen yul gyi don rang mtshan gyi skad cig go /'jug yul dang gzung yul la'ang / dang po rjes dpag gi 'jug yul/ gnyis pa nges pa ma drangs pa'i mngon sum gyi yul lo zhes chos mchog gis bshad la/ gsum pa dbang po'i mngon sum gyi yul yin zhes 'dod mod kyi/ gzung yul skad cig yin la/ 'jug yul rgyun la 'jog pas gnyis ka yin pa bzhag par dka'o/ /bzhi pa rtog pa log shes kyi snang yul lo/ /snang yul dang gzung yul la yang dang po rang rig gi yul yin pas rang rig 'dzin pa min no/ /gsum pa dbang po dang yid kyi mngon sum gyi gzung don/ bzhi pa bcad shes kyi yul rang mtshan no/ /gsum pa rtogs pa'i tshul la snang ba dang sel bas 'jug pa'i tshul gnyis las/ dang po la mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ mtshan gzhi rtsod spang bzhi las/ dang po la dgag pa ni/ rgya 'phying ru ba/ rang mtshan snang stobs kyis don dang mthun par 'jug pa zhes ni zla gnyis 'dzin pa'i dbang shes kyis ma nges so/ kha cig rtog med kyi shes pas mthong ba zhes pa ni/ rtog pas ma nges so/ /gnyis pa bzhag pa ni/ char ma phye bar gsal bar snang nas 'jug par byed pa ste/ kun las btus su der snang bas zhes dang / rnam 'grel du/ khyad par cha shas rnam spangs pa/ /mngon sum gyis ni gzung ba'ang / zhes so/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ 'khrul ma 'khrul gnyis las/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ char ma phye bar phyin ci log tu gsal bar snang nas 'jug par byed pa ste/ dbye na rten gyi sgo nas dbang shes dang yid shes bslad pa'i 'jug tshul gnyis so/ /char ma phye zhing phyin ci ma log par snang nas 'jug par byed pa ste/ dbye na rang rig dang / don rig mngon sum gyi 'jug tshul gnyis so/ /gsum pa mtshan nyid la gnyis las dngos ni/

gzung yul sgra lta bu'i steng na yod pa'i chos byas mi rtag la sogs pa rnams don dam par don ngo bo dbyer med kyi gcig yin pa mngon sum gyis mthong ma mthong gi cha tha dad med par cha tha dad snang ba'i sgo nas yul du byed pa yin no/ /gnyis pa rtags dgod pa ni/ bum pa dang bum pa'i skad cig chos can/ bum 'dzin mig shes la snang mi snang cha gnyis med de/ don dam par dbyer med kyi rdzas gcig yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa lung drang ba ni/ rnam 'grel du/ dam pa'i don gyi don rnams ni/ /rang gis 'dre dang tha dad med/ /ces dang / de phyir dngos po mthong ba yis/ /yon tan mtha' dag mthong ba nyid/ /ces so/ /bzhi pa rtsod spang ni/ de lta na/ bum pa chos can/ de mi rtag par rjes dpag tshad ma bsgrub mi dgos par thal/ de mi rtag par mngon sum tshad mas grub pa'i phyir zhe na/ ma nges te/ de mi rtag par ma nges pas rtag par 'dzin pa'i sgro 'dogs bsal ba'i phyir du rjes dpag 'jug dgos pa yin no/ /sgro 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan yang blo zhan pas rtag pa gcig tu 'khrul ba dang / skad cig 'dra ba la gzhan 'byung ba ste/ rnam 'grel du/ 'khrul pas nges par mi byed pas/ /bsgrub pa rab tu 'jug pa yin/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa sel bas 'jug pa la gnyis las/ sel ba ngos bzung ba la gnyis kyi mtshan nyid la dgag pa ni/ 'u yug pas/ chos gang gzhan dang ma 'dres pa zhes pa ni/ spyi gzhan sel ma yin par thal ba'i phyir/ bsod rgyal/ rtog ngor de yin bcad ldog ces pa ni shes bya sogs du mas ma nges so/ /gnyis pa bzhag pa ni/ de min dang bral bar rtog pas gzung bya'i yul te/ chos mchog gis sel pa grub pa'i mchod brjod du/ blo min phyi min de nyid ma yin sgro btags gang yin brjod pa yis zhes sel ba sgro btags 'ba' zhig tu bshad kyang / shākya blos/ rang mtshan la gzhan sel du bshad pa dang / rnam 'grel las/

sgra ni rnam gcod byed pa ni/ /dngos po'i chos la rig 'gyur ba/ /de ni de la yod ces bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas mi 'thad do/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ shākya blos bshad pa ltar sgro btags kyi tha snyad kyi rten du gyur pa'i rang mtshan dang / de min bcad ldog dang / rtog pa'i don spyi ste/ gzhan sel ba'i ngo bo dang / gzhan rnam par gcod pa dang / 'dis gzhan sel bar byed pa gzhan sel te/ rnam 'grel du/ mthun dngos gzhan gyi dngos dag las/ /ldog pa la ni rten pa can/ /zhes dang / ldog pa ngo bo nyid med phyir/ /zhes dang / spyi yi blo yang bslad pa yin/ /zhes so/ /des nas shākya blo las/ kun tu btags pa'i ldog pa zhes dang / sel ba sgro btags su gsungs pa ni bar pa la dgongs pa yin la/ snga phyi gnyis kyi dbye bsdu ni bshad zin zhing / bar pa la mtshan nyid ni/ de min bcad par btags pa ste/ /dbye na gnyis las ldog pa gcig gi mtshan nyid/ de min bcad pa'i sgo nas tha dad min par brtags pa ste/ dbye na dngos po dang / dngos med gnyis ka'i ldog pa gsum mo/ /ldog pa tha dad la mtshan nyid ni/ de min bcad pa'i sgo nas tha dad du btags pa'i chos so/ /dbye na me du'i ldog pa lta bu rdzas tha dad dang / byas mi rtag gi ldog pa lta bu ngo bo gcig rtag mi rtag tu gcig pa bkag pa'i tha dad gsum mo/ /ngo bo dang ldog pa tha dad la dpyad na mu bzhi ste/ mu dang po ka bum rang mtshan/ gnyis pa rang bzhin rtags kyi rtags chos/ gsum pa 'bras rtags kyi rtags chos/ bzhi pa bum ldog gcig lta bu/ ngo bo dang ldog pa gcig la'ang mu bzhi ste/ dang po byas mi rtag gnyis pa dngos med kyi ldog pa/ gsum pa bum pa dang bum pa/ bzhi pa ka bum dang gcig pa bkag pa'i tha dad la sogs pa'o/ /ldog pa dang rnam par gsal ba dang / rnam par gcod pa zhes pa ni/ rnam grangs su rgyal dbang blo las bshad do/ /gnyis pa de'i 'jug tshul bshad pa la/

mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po la dgag pa ni/ chu mig pas/ der zhen pa'i stobs kyis de ma yin du zhen pa skye ba'i gegs byed pa zhe na/ sgra rtag gam snyam pa'i the tshom sel 'jug min par thal te/ de la sgra mi rtag ste rtags kyi rjes dpag skye ba'i phyir ro/ /bzhag pa ni/ cha shas su phye nas sel pa la 'jug pa'o/ /gnyis pa dbye ba la/ ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/ sgra rtog gnyis so/ 'jug tshul gyi sgo nas dbye na sel 'jug phyin ci log ma log gnyis las/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ char phye nas don dang mi mthun par sel ba la 'jug pa'o/ /dbye na log rtog dang the tshom gyis 'jug pa gnyis so/ /gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni/ char phye nas don mthun du sel ba la 'jug pa'o/ /dbye na/ rjes dpag dang bcad shes so/ /byed po'i sgo nas dbye na dgag sgrub kyi sel pa gnyis sam/ med pa dang ma yin pa sel ba gnyis so/ /bsal bya'i sgo nas dbye na dgag bya shes bya la yod pa dang med pa bum med dang ri bong rwa med sogs sam/ sgro 'dogs yod pa dang med pa la 'jug pa gnyis so/ /yul gyi sgo nas dbye na/ mngon gyur dang lkog gyur la 'jug pa gnyis so/ /tshul 'di gzhung dang mkhas pa'i lugs bzhin bkod/ /'di la gzhan du 'chad rnams gol ba'i rgyu/ /de phyir rnam dag rigs tshul dri med 'di/ /gzhan la dga' blo btang nas blang ba'i rigs/ /rigs pa'i de kho na nyid rnam par nges pa las yul yul can spyir bstan pa'i yongs su bcad pa de gnyis pa'o// ༈ /gnyis pa khyad par tshad ma gtan la dbab pa la/ mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis so/ /dang po la gsum ste/ dngos don brjod/ bsal bya bshad/ sgro 'dogs sel lo/ /dang po la/ dgag gzhag spang gsum las/ dang po ni/ bram zes bden pa'i don rtogs chos gsum ldan te/ ngo bo'i khyad par sgro 'dogs gcod pa/ 'dzin stangs kyi khyad par don la mi 'khrul ba/ yul gyi khyad par sngar ma rtogs la 'jug pa ste/

rtog ge tho bar/ gzhan dag bden pa'i don rtogs smra zhes pa ltar ro/ /de lta na bden pa'i don tshad mas gnod pa'am brdzun pa ma yin pa gang yin/ dang po ltar na/ tshad ma'i gnod bya gnod bya'i tha snyad du 'jal ba'i rjes dpag tshad ma ma yin par thal lo/ /gnyis pa ltar na kun rdzob 'jal ba'i tshad ma de tshad ma min par thal zhing / mngon sum yang der thal te/ sgro 'dogs mi gcod pa'i phyir dang / rang gi kyang 'dzin stangs don la mi 'khrul bar thal lo/ /chos mchog dang / lha dbang blo nges shes mi 'dren pa tshad ma yin zhes pa'ang mi 'thad de/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes tshad ma min par thal te/ shes brjod kyi yul las 'das pas nges shes yod par ma grub cing / yod na tshad min gyi blo yod par thal ba'i phyir te/ chos mchog tu/ rtags med pa'i rnam par rtog pa thams cad ni nges par byed pa med pa'i phyir gzhan du dogs pa ma bzlog pas the tshom za ba yin no zhes pas so/ /nges shes yod par yang ma grub ste/ rgyud gzhan gyur par/ bcom ldan rnams kyi don thams cad thugs su chud pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa ste/ rnam pa thams cad du shes pa dang brjod pa'i yul las 'das pa'i phyir ro zhes so/ /'dod par mi nus te/ rang 'grel du/ thams cad gzigs pa'i gzigs pa log ni pa gang na yang med pa go bar byed pa yin zhes so/ /rgyan mkhan pos/ don dam gyi tshad ma'i mtshan nyid ma shes don gsal dang / tha snyad pa'i tshad ma'i mtshan nyid mi slu ba yin/ zhes pa'ang mi 'thad de/ ma shes don gyi gsal byed kyang zhes pa'i sdud pa'i tshig mi 'thad par 'gyur zhing / rang gi mtshan nyid mi shes pas shes pa gang yin dgos phyir zhes pa dang yang 'gal lo/ /gnyis pa bzhag pa la/ bzhed don ngos gzung / de'i rang bzhin nges par bya/ nges byed tshad ma bshad pa gsum gyi dang po ni/ tshad ma snga mas rtogs zin byed pa ma nyams pa'i don yin pa'i rang gi gzhal bya la mi slu ba'i shes pa ste/

rnam 'grel du/ ma rtogs don gyi gsal byed kyang / /zhes dang / tshad ma slu med can shes pa/ /zhes dang / chos mchog chung bar/ mi slu bar byed pa'i shes pa ni yang dag pa'i shes pa yin no zhes so/ /gnyis pa la gnyis las/ gzhal bya ni 'jug yul te/ rnam 'grel du/ blang dang dor bya'i dngos po yi/ /'jug la de gtso yin phyir dang / /zhes dang / rang gi mtshan nyid bcad phyir ro/ /zhes so/ mi slu ba ni/ yul dang yul can gyi mi slu ba gnyis las dang po ni tshad ma gnyis kyis yongs su bcad pa ltar rang gi ngo bo grub pa dang / de ji lta ba bzhin rtogs pas de las skyes bu 'jug par byed pa ni 'jug yul de dang phrad par byed pa yin te/ rnam 'grel du/ don byed nus par gnas pa ni/ /mi slu zhes dang / lha dbang blo las/ mi slu ba de yang don yongs su bcad nas 'jug pa na/ don gyi rang gi nus pa grub pas ji ltar 'dod pa'i don de lta bu'i ngo bo mi slu ba'i yul gyi chos dang / de'i de lta bur gyur pa rtogs pa na shes pa mi slu ba ni yul can gyi chos yin zhes so/ /mngon sum rtog pa med pas ji ltar gcod ce na/ shākya blor/ mngon sum ni rnam par rtog pa med pa nyid kyi phyir nges pa ma yin mod kyi 'on kyang der snang bar skyes pa tsam yin no/ /rjes su dpag pa ni nges pa nyid yin no zhes so/ /de la mngon sum gyi 'jug pa ni gnyis te/ dang po ba dang / goms pa can no/ /dang po ni mngon sum de'i yul gyi rgyun la 'dod pa'i don byed pa yin min du the tshom za ba ste/ 'di yang mi slu bar nges pa'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir mi slu bar bzhag ste/ shākya blor/ mi slu bar nges pa'i rgyu nyid yin pa'i phyir mi slu ba yin no/ /de ltar na mi slu ba ni 'dir phrad par nus pa'o zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ shin tu goms pa gsal bas 'khrul rgyu med pa'i mngon sum skyes pa na rang nyid kyis nges pa grangs pa'i tshul gyis tshad ma gzhan la mi ltos par don de la 'jug par byed pa'o/

de ltar na 'jug pa dang bzlog pa'i rgyu gnyis gnyis te shākya blor/ de ltar na 'jug par byed pa la don la the tshom za ba dang / don nges pa dang / rgyu rnam pa gnyis yin no/ /ldog pa la yang don med pa la the tshom za ba dang / don nges pa dang / rgyu rnam pa gnyis so/ /ldog pa la yang don med pa la the tshom za ba dang / don med par nges pa gnyis kho na yin no zhes so/ /gsum pa nges byed tshad ma bshad pa la rang nges dang gzhan nges gnyis kyi dang po ni/ rang rig pa dang rnal 'byor pa'i mngon sum don byed pa'i shes pa goms pa can/ rjes dpag rnams te/ kā ma la shī las/ dper na rang rig pa'i mngon sum dang rnal 'byor pa'i shes pa dang / don byed pa'i shes pa dang / rjes su dpag pa dang / goms pa dang ldan pa'i mngon sum lta bu ste/ de ni 'khrul pa'i rgyu spangs pa'i phyir goms pa'i stobs kyis rang nyid las nges pa yin no zhes dang / rtog ge'i skad las kyang de dang 'dra bar bshad do/ /don byed pa ni dro reg gi yul can gyi lus shes dang / bsreg 'tshed kyi yul can gyi mig shes la sogs pa'o/ goms pa can yang dper na/ nor bu dang / de'i gzugs byas pa mdog dbyibs mtshungs pa mthong ba na goms pa'i dbang gis mthong ba tsam gyis tha dad du nges pa ste/ shākya blor/ nor bu gzugs byas la sogs pa/ de rig shes pa rjes dpag las/ /byung min gzhan rnams la brjod med/ /goms pa nyid las skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'khrul rgyu can dang goms pa dang / blo zhan pa'i mngon sum sogs te/ kā ma la shī las/ cung zad gcig ni gzhan la ste/ /zhes dang / 'khrul pa'i rgyu mtshan ma spangs pa'i mngon sum lta bu ste/ goms pa dang don byed pa'i shes pa dag ma thob pa'i phyir zhes dang / rtog ge'i skad las/ blo zhan pas ni de dang mthun pa'i rjes su dpag pa las so/ /zhes so/ /dang po yang gzhan las nges te/

shākya blor/ dang po'i me dang chur snang ba'i shes pa yang goms pa med pa na rang rgyud kyi tshad ma nyid kyi bzung du zin yang 'khrul pa'i rgyu mtshan yod pa'i phyir nges pa bskyed pa'i nus pa med pa de bas na de la phyis kyi tshad ma 'jug pas tshad ma nyid du rnam par bzhag pa de ltar na gzhan las tshad ma yin no zhes so/ /des na mngon sum la rang nges gzhan nges gnyis dang rjes dpag rang nges kho na'o/ /rang nges gzhan nges kyi khyad par ni mi slu rang stobs gzhan stobs las nges so/ /gsum pa rtsod spang ni/ dngos med 'jal ba'i rjes dpag tshad ma ma yin par thal/ 'jug yul la mi slu ba yin pa'i phyir te/ 'jug yul med pas so zhe na/ ma grub ste/ dngos med rtogs pa'i blo de de'i 'jug yul yin la/ dgag rtags rnams la yang dgag bya'i chos kyis dben pa'i dgag gzhi 'jug yul du byed pa'i phyir te/ lha dbang blos/ bum pa la sogs pa don gyi bya ba byed pa dgag par bya ba med pa nyid du rtogs pa'i phyir ram/ phyogs la sogs pa des dben pa'i yul de ltar des dben pa'i ngo bor shes pa'i phyir/ don dam par mi dmigs pa yang rang gi mtshan nyid kyi rten can nyid yin no/ gang du nam mkha' la sogs pa rnam par gcod pa na phyi rol gyi dngos po'i rten med pa de la yang nam mkha'i rgyus stong pa de'i rnam par rtog pa'i blo nyid rten yin pa de ltar na tha dad du dngos po la reg pa yin no zhes so/ /yang na 'jug pa'i yul ni yod pa med pa gnyis yin la/ mi slu ba yang rtogs pa'i don la skyes bu bcug pa yin te/ chos mchog che bar/ 'jug pa'i yul yang yod pa dang med pa'o zhes dang / med pa'i tha snyad sgrub par byed pa yang tha snyad du rung ba yin pa'i phyir thob par bya ba'i yul nyid do zhes so/ /chung bar rtogs pa'i don la skyes bu bcug par gyur pa ni don dang phrad par gyur pa yang yin no/

/de ltar na don rtogs par gyur pa'i phyir tshad ma'i bya ba rdzogs pa yin no zhes so/ /gal te the tshom dang log shes kyang tshad mar thal/ de las kyang don la mi slu ba yod pa'i phyir zhe na/ ma nges te/ 'dod don kho na dang phrad par byed pa mi slu ba yin pa'i phyir dang / de dag ni mi 'dod pa dang phrad pa yang srid pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa bsal bya bshad pa la mtshan nyid dbye ba/ grangs nges gsum gyi dang po la dgag pa ni/ kha cig rang ldog la tshad ma'i mtshan nyid ma tshang ba zhes pa ni/ dngos med kyi ma nges so/ bzhag pa ni/ rang gis yongs su bcad pa'i yul la mi slu ba min pa'i shes pa ste/ rtog ge'i skad du/ don thob par rung ba ma yin pa nyid kyi phyir tshad ma ma yin pa kho na'o zhes so/ /gnyis pa la dgag gzhag gnyis las dang po la/ grangs mang ba dang / nyung bar rtog pa dgag pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ snga rabs pa dag snang la ma nges pa bcad shes/ yid dpyod/ log shes/ the tshom ste lnga yin la/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ 'dzin pa gang snang yul la nges shes mi 'dren pa zhes pa ni/ so skye'i rang rig chos can/ myong ba gnyis med kyi shes pa la ltos te 'dzin pa gang shes mi 'dren pa yin par thal/ gzung 'dzin gnyis med kyi shes pa snang la ma nges pa yin pa'i phyir te/ shākya blor/ bzung du zin yang 'khrul pa'i sa bon dang rjes su 'brel pa'i phyir ji ltar ldog pa bzhin du gnyis med pa'i nges pa skye bar mi 'gyur ro zhes so/ /'dod mi nus te/ de nyid du/ rang rig pa tsam yang 'dzin pa'i sgras brjod pa ma yin no zhes dang / tshad min du'ang thal ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa mtshan nyid ni/ rang gi tshad mas sngar rtogs kyi byed pa ma nyams pa'i don la sgro 'dogs dang 'gal bar 'jug pa ste/ dbye na mngon sum bcad shes sngo 'dzin phyi ma lta bu dang / rtog pa bcad shes tshad ma gnyis kyi rjes kye nges shes lta bu'o zhe na/

sngo 'dzin phyi ma chos can/ bcad shes min par thal/ mtshan nyid de ma tshang ba'i phyir/ ma grub ste/ sngar rtogs zin gyi rigs la 'jug pa'i phyir zhe na/ ma grub ste/ rigs rgyu sgro btags yin pas mi 'jal ba'i phyir dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes bcad shes su thal la/ 'dod na/ tshad min du thal ba'i phyir dang / yid dpyad la mtshan nyid ni/ sgro 'dogs dang mi 'gal bar don bden pa mtha' gcig tu nges pa zhes pa ni rang tshig dang 'gal lo/ /dbye na rgyu mtshan med pa'i yid dpyod dang / rgyu mtshan can gnyis te/ 'di la don skyon can/ gzhal bya'i rtags las sgra mi rtag par nges pa lta bu dang / blo skyon can phyogs nges shing khyab pa ma nges pa'i dus su byas pa'i rtags las sgra mi rtag par nges pa lta bu'o zhe na/ yid dpyod chos can/ rang yul la yid dpyod min par thal/ rang yul la sgro 'dogs dang 'gal ba'i phyir te/ yul bden pa mtha' gcig tu nges pa'i phyir/ khyab pa yod/ rnam 'grel du/ nges pa dang ni sgro 'dogs yod/ /gnod bya gnod byed ngo ba'i phyir/ /zhes so/ /yang rgyu mtshan can dang rgyu mtshan med pa'i yid dpyod du 'dod pa de dag chos can/ the tshom las gzhan pa'i tshad min gyi blor mi 'thad par thal/ the tshom yin pa'i phyir te/ nges byed kyi rgyu mtshan ma nges pa'i phyir/ khyab pa yod/ chos mchog tu/ khyim na 'dug pa ni khron pa na chu yod do zhes gcig gi char zhen par byed kyang nges par byed pa'i rgyu med pas chu med pa'i dgos pa ma bzlog pa'i phyir shes pa de ni the tshom kho na'o/ /gang yang rgyu med par me'i steng du sbrang bu'i tshogs 'dus pa la du bar nges pa las yang dag pa'i me nges pa de yang zhes pas so/ /kha cig de dang de min du 'dzin pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi ma gtogs pa zhes bya ba'i blo yod la/ dbye na/ sgra mi shes pa la su ban+ti lta bu yul de blo ma zhugs pa dang /

sgra rtag mi rtag dris pa na dpyod pa lta bu zhugs kyang tshor ba'i bya ba ma rdzogs pa dang / dpyad kyang don ma nges pa lta bu tshol ba'i bya ba rdzogs kyang ma rnyed pa gsum mo zhes pa'ang mi 'thad de/ rang rig ma rtogs par thal ba'i phyir dang / yul de gtan ma rtogs na de la tshad min blor mi 'thad la/ dbye ba gsum gyi dang po yid dpyod/ gnyis pa dang gsum pa the tshom yin pas log dang the tshom las gzhan du mi 'thad do/ /gnyis pa grangs nyung bar rtog pa dgag pa ni/ chos mchog tshad min gyi blo thams cad the tshom du 'du zhes pa'ang mi 'thad de/ tshad ma gnyis kyi rjes kyi nges shes chos can/ the tshom du thal/ rtags la ma brten pa'i rtogs pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa zhal gyis bzhes/ 'dod na/ rang yul la mtha' gcig tu nges pa'i shes pa ma yin par thal/ the tshom yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa zhal gyis bzhes te/ chos mchog tu/ the tshom gyi shes pa yang yod dam med/ bum pa'am snam bu zhes gnyis ka'i cha la dmigs pa yin la zhes pas so/ /gnyis pa bzhag pa log pa log rtog dang the tshom gnyis te/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba'o/ /dang po la dgag pa ni/ kha cig don dang mi mthun par 'dzin pa zhe na/ sgra rtag gam snyam pa'i the tshom log shes su thal bas so/ /chu mig pas/ der ma yin la der 'dzin zhes pa'ang the tshom kyi ma nges so/ /bzhag pa ni/ phyin ci log tu mtha' gcig tu 'dzin pa ste/ shākya blor/ de med pa la der 'dzin par zhugs pa'i phyir 'khrul pa yin no/ /zhes dang / lha dbang blor/ log par zhen pa'i phyir 'khrul pa yin no zhes so/ dbye na rtog pa dang rtog med log shes gnyis so/ /dang po la snang yul dang zhen yul la 'khrul pa'i log shes dang / gnyis pa la dbang shes dang yid shes 'khrul pa gnyis so/ /the tshom bshad zin to// ༈ /gsum pa grangs nges la gnyis las dngos ni/ blo gzhir byas la yul de la kha phyogs ma phyogs gnyis las/

ma phyogs na de la blo min la/ phyogs pa la ji lta ba bzhin rtogs ma rtogs gnyis las/ rtogs na tshad ma/ ma rtogs na tshad min yin la/ ji lta ba bzhin ma rtogs pa la yang mtha' gcig tu 'dzin ma 'dzin gnyis las/ mi 'dzin na the tshom/ 'dzin na log shes yin pas rnam bcad la tshad min gyi blo log shes the tshom gnyis su nges pas yongs gcod la the tshom dang / phyin ci log dang bral ba'i mi slu ba'i shes pa tshad mar grub ste/ rtog ge'i skad du/ 'dis don 'jal bas na tshad ma yin la de nyid yang dag pa'i shes pa ste/ the tshom dang phyin ci log gi skyon dang bral ba nyid kyi phyir ro/ /slu ba med pa'i shes pa ni 'jig rten na yang dag pa'i shes par brjod la/ the tshom dang phyin ci log gi shes pa dag la mi slu ba dag yod pa yang ma yin te zhes so/ /rtsod spang ni/ rnam 'grel du/ gzung ba 'dzin phyir kun rdzob ni/ /mi 'dod ces tshad ma'i rjes kyi nges shes tshad min du gsungs pa de 'dir ma 'dus so zhe na skyon med de/ de log shes yin pa'i phyir te/ gtan tshigs thigs par/ du ba dang bcas pa'i phyogs don gzhan gyis dben pa'i ngo bo can thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag nyid du mngon sum gyis mthong ba la/ ji ltar mthong ba tha dad pa'i yul can dran pa rtags shes skye'o/ /de la dang po yul thun mong ma yin pa mthong ba yin pa kho na tshad ma yin no/ /de de ltar mthong na mngon sum gyi stobs kyis de gang dang gang gis thun mong ma yin pa de'i thun mong ma yin pa nyid de las tha dad par mngon par brjod pa de ma yin pa las log pa'i yul can gyi dran pa skyes pa ni/ ji ltar yongs su mthong ba'i rnam pa 'dzin pa'i phyir tshad ma ma yin te zhes so/ /gsum pa sgro 'dogs sel tshul la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ sel tshul gsum gyi dang po la dgag pa ni/ chu mig pa/ blo gang tshad ma'i gnod byar gyur pa zhes pa ni tshad ma dang lhan cig mi gnas pa'i 'gal bar 'gyur bas tshad ma dang ngo bo mi gcig par thal lo/

/bzhag pa ni/ phyin ci log tu sgro 'dogs pa'i 'khrul shes te/ de ltar yang / shākya blo las/ skad cig ma snga ma de phyis kyang ngo bor sgro btags pa'i phyir gnas par 'khrul lo zhes so/ /dbye na/ zhen yul la 'khrul ba'i log shes dang the tshom mo/ /gsum pa ni/ sgro 'dogs sel byed yang dag pa'i nges pa dang sgro 'dogs gnyis yul gcig la dmigs nas rnam pa don dang mthun mi mthun du zhen pa'i sgo nas gnod bya gnod byed du 'gyur ba yin la/ de yang dang por sgro 'dogs rgyun ldan du 'byung ba las yang dag nges pa skyes pa sgro 'dogs kyi zhen stangs sun phyung ste rgyun bcad nas rang gi byed pa ma nyams kyi bar du sgro 'dogs res 'byung ba skye ba'i gegs byed pas ngo bo tha dad pa yin te/ rnam 'grel du/ cha shas sgro 'dogs ji snyed pa/ /zhes dang / chos mchog tu/ sgro 'dogs pa 'di res 'ga' ba yin na ni gnod par 'gyur zhes dang / rnam 'grel du/ skye 'dod nyes pa bcom pa'i phyir/ /gang la skyon rnams 'gog byed pa/ /des bskyed las la nus 'gyur gyi/ /ji ltar byas pa nyams par 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ chos mchog las/ tshad ma'i dbye ba ni yul gyi dbye ba las yin te/ zhes pa ltar/ rnam par 'jog pa la gzhal bya dang 'jal byed kyi dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po la dbye ba'i gzhi ni gzhal bya tsam ste/ de'i mtshan nyid/ tshad mas gtan la dbab bya'i yul te/ chos mchog tu/ gzhal bya yang tshad ma'i yul yin pa'i phyir zhes so/ /des na tshad ma gnyis las gzhan pa'i shes pa la gzhal bya med de/ de nyid du/ mngon sum dang rjes su dpag pa dag las gzhan pa'i shes pa yang yul dang ldan pa ma yin no zhes so/ /dbye ba'i don la/ gzhal bya mngon gyur dang lkog gyur gnyis las/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ rang gi ngo bo char ma phye bar gsal bar snang ba'i sgo nas gzhal bar bya ba ste/ lha dbang blor/

gang gis gang gi rang gi ngo bo 'dzin pa de ni mngon sum yin zhes so/ /gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ rtags yang dag las spyi'i tshul gyis gzhal bar bya ba ste/ rnam 'grel du/ de tshe go byed rjes 'gro ba/ /spyi yi ngo bo nyid du rtogs/ /shes so/ /rnam gzhag ni/ gzhal bya de gnyis kyang lta ba po gcig la ltos nas 'jog gi gzhan du na 'chol par 'gyur te/ chos mchog tu/ rtogs pa po gcig la ltos pa'i phyir 'chol ba med ces dang / lha dbang blor/ de lta ma yin na lta ba po dang snang ba dag gi gnas skabs kyi khyad par gzhan du gyur pa na mngon sum dang / lkog tu gyur pa dag rnam pa gzhan du 'gyur ba'i phyir mtshan nyid 'chol ba yin no zhes so/ /gnyis pa 'jal byed kyi dbye ba la mngon sum dang rjes dpag gnyis las/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ gsal bya/ tshad 'bras bzhi'i dang po la gnyis las/ dgag pa ni/ kha cig rtog bral ma 'khrul ba zhe na/ dngos med kyis ma nges te/ gzhi grub nas 'khrul pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhag pa la gsum las/ dang po ni/ rtog bral ma 'khrul ba'i shes pa ste/ rnam nges su/ 'khrul pa ma bskyed cing rnam par rtog pa med pa'i shes pa ni mngon sum mo zhes so/ /gnyis pa de gtan la dbab pa la gsum las dang po ma 'khrul ba ngos bzung ba ni/ chos mchog bzung ba ma 'khrul ba yin no zhe na/ kun mkhyen gyi mngon sum dang rang rig chos can/ mngon sum min par thal/ ma 'khrul ba min pa'i phyir te/ gzung don la ma 'khrul ba med pa'i phyir te/ gzung 'dzin med pa'i phyir/ des gzhal bya la mi slu ba nyid ma 'khrul ba'i don yin te/ rnam nges las/ mngon sum yang don la mi slu ba nyid las tshad ma yin no/ /mi slu ba yang don las bdag nyid thob pa'i phyir te zhes gsungs shing / kā ma la shī la dang / dul lha dang / thar pa 'byung gnas sbas pa rnams kyang de dang mthun par 'chad do/ /gzhan du na mngon sum la mi slu ba med pas tshad ma min par 'gyur zhing /

de 'dod par yang mi rigs pas so/ /gnyis pa rtog bral ngos bzung ba ni/ rtog pa zhes pa sgra don 'drer rung du 'dzin pa yin zhing / bral ba yang sgra don mi 'dzin pa yin te/ rnam 'grel du/ rang gi ngo bo sgra don min/ /de phyir de la kun mngon sum/ /zhes so/ /rtog pa 'di yang mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i yid shes dang mtshungs ldan gyi shes rab dang dran pa ste/ mdzod du/ nges par rtog dang rjes dran pa'i/ /rnam par rtog pas rnam smin rtog /ces so/ /gsum pa bsal bya sel tshul ni/ rtog bral gyi rjes dpag dang / ma 'khrul bas rtog med 'khrul pa gcod do/ /gnyis pa dbye ba la/ dbye ba dngos dang / phye ba'i dgos pa gnyis las/ dang po la/ dbang po/ yid/ rang rig rnal 'byor mngon sum bzhi las dang po la/ rgyu mtshan nyid/ dbye/ tha snyad kyi rgyu bzhi las/ dang po ni dbang po'i mngon sum thams cad rgyu rkyen gsum las skye ste/ rnam 'grel du/ gal te ji ltar yul dbang po/ /tshogs pa zhes dang / snang dbang yid la byed pa las shes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de la bdag rkyen dbang po la mtshan nyid ni/ nang gi skye mched gang rang gi bdag 'bras su gyur pa'i shes pa dmigs rung du byed pa ste/ dbye na gzugs can gyi dbang po lnga dang / yid dbang ngo / /'di dag chu mig pas rdul phran du 'dod pa'ang mi 'thad de/ rags pa yin pas so/ /dmigs rkyen la mtshan nyid ni/ phyi rol gyi rnam pa gtod byed de/ dbye na/ don dang shes pa gnyis sam/ dbang shes 'khrul gyi dmigs rkyen gnyis so/ /de ma thag rkyen la mtshan nyid di/ rang gi nyer len can gyi shis pa rigs par skyed byed de/ dbye na/ rtog pa rtog med gnyis so/ rkyen gsum po des shes pa la bya ba gsum byed de/ gtan tshigs thigs par/ 'di ltar mtshungs pa de ma thag pa'i rkyen las ni mig gi rnam par shes pa dmigs pa'i bdag nyid yin la/ dmigs pa'i bdag nyid de nyid mig gi dbang po las ni gzung 'dzin rung ba nyid du so sor nges pa yin la/

yul las ni de dang 'dra ba'i ngo bo can nyid ces bya ba yin no zhes so/ /'di'i 'grel par/ rgyu'i rkyen gyis ni dge ba la sogs pa nyid du nges par byed do zhes rkyen bzhir yang gsungs so/ /gnyis pa mtshan nyid la dgag pa ni/ bdag rkyen dbang po gzugs can la brten dang dbang po'i gzung don la rtogs bral ma 'khrul ba zhes pa ni yid kyi mngon sum gyis ma nges so/ /bzhag pa ni dbang shes ma 'khrul ba ste/ chos mchog chung par/ dbang po'i shes pa ni dbang po'i shes pa zhes bya ba ste zhes pa ltar ro/ /de la dbang shes tsam gyi mtshan nyid ni/ bdag rkyen dbang po gzugs can gyis byas pa'i gzhan rig rtog med do/ /gsum pa dbye na/ dbang po lnga la brten pa'i mag shes sogs lnga'o/ /bzhi pa tha snyad kyi rgyu ni/ dbang po gzugs can de dbang shes kyis thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyu yin pas de'i sgo nas tha snyad btags te rnga'i sgra dang nas kyi myu gu zhes pa bzhin te/ tshad ma mdor/ thun mong min pa'i rgyu yi phyir/ /de yang tha snyad dbang pos byas/ /de shes pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa yid kyi mngon sum la/ mtshan nyid dbye ba/ rgyu/ rnam gzhag bzhi'i dang po la dgag pa ni/ chu mig pas bdag rkyen yid kyi dbang po la brten nas dbang po'i gzung don gyi skad cig gnyis pa la rtog bral ma 'khrul zhing gzhal bya la mi slu ba zhes pa ni dbang shes kyi gzung don gyi skad cig gnyis pa 'dzin pa'i dbang shes de chos can/ yid kyi mngon sum du thal te de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ bdag rkyen yid kyi dbang po la brten par thal/ yid kyi mngon sum dang rgyu tshogs pa gcig la rag las pa'i phyir/ 'dis ni yid dbang la brten pa'i shes pa ma 'khrul ba zhes pa'ang khegs so/ /bzhag pa ni/ de ma thag rkyen dbang shes kyis bskyed pa'i yid shes rtog bral ma 'khrul ba'o/ /de yang dbang shes de ma thag rkyen las/ byung zhing de don de ma thag

/'dzin par byed pa yid kyang ngo / /zhes rnam nges las kyang / rtog ge'i skad du/ rang gi yul gyi de ma thag pa'i yul lhan cig byed pa can gyi dbang po'i shes pa mtshungs pa de ma thag pa'i rkyen gyis bskyed pa yid kyi rnam par shes pa'o zhes so/ /dbye na/ mig la brten pa'i yid kyi mngon sum sogs lnga'o/ /rgyu la dgag pa ni snga rabs pa dag rnam shes tshogs bdun tu 'dod pa'i lugs la nyon yid dang tshogs drug tu 'dod pa ltar na tshogs drug snga ma 'gags pa'i tshogs drug da lta ba yin zhes 'dod do/ /de lta na dgra bcom pa chos can/ yid dbang med par thal/ nyon yid med pa'i phyir te/ dgra bcom med ces sum cu par ro/ /'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam na'ang yid dbang med par thal te/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam na'ang med sum pa dang zhes so/ /yid kyi mngon sum chos can/ phyin ci log tu thal/ nyon yid las byung ba'i phyir/ khyab pa yod de/ sum cu pa'i 'grel bshad du lhas byas par/ nyon mongs can gyi yid ni dus tha dad du phyin ci log gi rgyu yin te zhes so/ /thal ba snga ma gnyis 'dod na dgra bcom dang 'das pa'i lam chos can/ dbang po dgu med par thal/ yid dbang med pa'i phyir/ khyab pa yod de/ mdzod du/ mthong sgom mi slob lam la dgu/ /gsum pa yin zhes dang / de'i 'grel par/ yid dang / bde ba dang / btang snyoms dang / dad pa la sogs pa lnga dang / dbang po de dag ni lam gsum du dbang po gsum zhes bya ste/ mthong ba'i lam la ni mi shes pa kun shes par byed pa'i dbang po zhes bya'o/ /sgom pa'i lam la ni kun shes pa'i dbang po zhes bya'o/ /mi slob pa'i lam la ni kun shes pa dang ldan pa'i dbang po zhes bya'o zhes so/ /de nyid kyi phyir 'dod par yang mi nus so/ /kha cig kun gzhi yid dbang du 'dod pa'ang mi 'thad de/ kun gzhi chos can/ dge mi dger 'gyur srid par thal/ 'dod mi nus te/

lung ma bstan kho na yin pas so/ /yang rnam par shes pa'i khams drug 'gags ma thag par thal/ yid dbang yin pa'i phyir te/ dbye bshad las/ rnam par shes pa'i khams drug po de dag ni 'gags ma thag pa la yid kyi khams zhes bya'o/ /zhes so/ /yang tshogs drug da lta ba chos can/ dbang yid ma yin par thal/ ma 'gags pa'i phyir/ de yid dbang yin na/ sa mang po par/ yid gang zhe na/ gang mig gi rnam par shes pa'i snga rol du 'das ma thag pa'i rnam par shes pa'o/ /zhes pa dang 'gal lo/ /gnyis pa bzhag pa ni/ 'gags ma thag pa'i tshogs drug snga ma de nyid kyi dbang po yin te/ mdzod du/ drug po 'das ma thag pa yi/ /rnam shes gang yin de yid do/ /zhes dang / de'i rang 'grel du/ rnam par shes pa gang dang gang 'gags ma thag pa de ni yid kyi khams shes bya ste/ dper na bu de nyid gzhan gyi phar 'gyur pa dang / 'bras bu de nyid gzhan gyi sa bon yin pa lta bu'o zhes dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i rten ni 'gags ma thag pa yid do zhes so/ /chos mchog che bar yang / rten tha dad pas thad dad pa'i sems kyi khams drug po de dag nyid gang 'das ma thag pa phyi ma skye bar byed pa de nyid ni yid ces brjod pa'o zhes dang / shākya blor/ gzugs la sogs pa'i skad cig ma gnyis pa'i yul can gyi yul de'i rten ni dbang po'i shes pa yin no zhes so/ /de ltar shes sgo lnga'i shes pa dbang po gnyis la brten te 'das ma thag pa'i yid dang gzugs can gyi dbang po ste/ mdzod 'grel du/ de ltar na rnam par shes pa'i tshogs lnga po de dag rten ni dbang po gnyis gnyis yin no zhes so/ /des na mig shes kyi bdag rkyen dang de ma thag rkyen gnyis la mu bzhi ste dbang po mig dbang / gnyis pa sems byung 'das ma thag pa/ gsum pa 'das ma thag pa'i yid/ bzhi pa 'gags ma thag pa'i sems byung ma gtogs pa'i chos tha dad do/ /de bzhin du lus shes la sogs pa gzhan la yang sbyor ro zhes so/

/mdzod 'grel las 'byung ngo / /gzung don ni de ma thag rkyen dbang shes kyi gzung don gyi skad cig gnyis pa'o/ /de ma thag rkyen ni yid dbang dang / sems byung 'das ma thag pa gnyis gang rung ste/ mdzod 'grel du/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa yid tshig snga ma dang sbyar ba ste/ re shig gang rten gyi dngos por yin pa de ni mtshungs pa de ma thag pa'i rkyen gyi dngos por yang yin no/ /mtshungs pa de ma thag pa'i rkyen gyi dngos po yin la rten gyi dngos po ma yin pa yang yod de/ chos kyi khams sems las byung ba 'das ma thag pa'o zhes so/ /a bh+yas kyang / 'jigs pa med pa'i gzhung 'grel du/ yid kyi mngon sum du bdag rkyen 'di dang 'dra ba dang / de nyid de'i de ma thag rkyen du yang bshad do/ /dbang shes snga ma de dngos po gcig yin yang bya ba gnyis byed pas rkyen gnyis yin no/ /bzhi pa rigs mi mthun sel tshul ni/ de ma thag rkyen dbang shes kyis bskyed pa zhes pas gzhan gyi dbang shes kyis dmigs rkyen byas pa'i yid shes rnal 'byor mngon sum sel/ yid shes zhes pas dbang shes dang rang rig sel zhing / rtog bral ma 'khrul bas yid shes rtog pa gcod do/ /lnga pa rnam gzhag la bzhed don la dngos dang / lugs gzhan bstan pa la gnyis las/ dang po la gsum las/ dgag pa ni/ chos mchog mig shes kyi rgyun 'gags pa'i mjug thogs su yid kyi mngon sum skye zhe na/ mi 'thad de/ dbang shes rgyun chad pa na yid kyi mngon sum snang rung mi dmigs pa'i phyir dang / de 'dra yod par dran pa'i dran shes don mthun ma dmigs pa'i phyir/ yang mig btsum pa na gzugs mthong bar thal ba'i phyir ro/ /yang rgyan mkhan pos/ goms las mdun na gnas pa la/ /'di zhes sogs pa gang / /mngon du byed phyir de la ni/ /yid kyi mngon sum yin par 'dod/ /ces ngo shes yid kyi mngon sum du 'dod cing / de yang mig shes dang spel na skye'o zhes pa'ang mi 'thad de/

ngo shes rtog pa yin pas mngon sum du 'gal ba'i phyir dang / rgyun ldan du 'jug pa'i dbang shes snga phyi rnam chos can/ bar chad par thal/ yid shes kyis bar bcad pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhag pa ni/ bye brag smra ba dang mdo sde pa'i lugs gnyis te/ shākya blor/ bye brag tu smra ba'i phyogs la yang / mig dang / gzugs dang / mig gi rnam par shes pa nyid yin la/ gnyis pa la yid kyi rnam par shes pa yin no zhes dang / mdo sde pa'i gzhung gi rjes su 'brangs nas brjod pa yin te zhes pa'i mjug thogs su/ skad cig ma dang por gzugs legs pa dang / gnyis par mig la sogs pa'i rnam par shes pa dang / gsum par yid kyi rnam par shes pa yin zhes pa la/ chos kyi grags pas phyi ma 'di zhal gyis bzhes pa yin te/ dbang shes dang yid shes kyi gzung don dus mtshungs par bshad pas so/ /de bzhin du skad cig ma dang po la mig dang gzugs dang / gnyis pa la mig gi rnam par shes pa dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i yul don yin zhes shākya blo las so/ /'di thogs med kyis kyang yod par yid kyis myong ba'i mngon sum dang zhes par bshad do/ /gsum pa rtsod spang ni/ chos mchog na re/ mig byed pa dang ldan zhing don dbang po'i spyod yul du gyur pa na gzugs sogs shes pa de mig kho na la mi brten na mig la brten pa'i shes pa yod par mi 'thad de/ mig dbang de gzugs shes pa gcig gi rgyu yin la gzhan gyi rgyu min pa 'gal ba'i phyir zhe na/ skyon med de/ yul dang dbang po drug tshang ni yid byed gcig gis mngon sum drug cig car bskyed pa bzhin du mig dang yid dang dbang blo gnyis ka'i rkyen du 'gyur zhing / mngon sum drug skye ba na rten dbang po tha dad pa bzhin 'dir yang yin no/ /gnyis pa lugs gzhan brtan pa ni/ dbyig gnyen gyi mdzod 'grel du/ yid shes kyi dmigs pa dus gsum du bshad cing sum cu pa la sogs par rtog bcas 'ba' zhig tu gsungs pas mngon sum du mi bzhed la/

mdo dgongs pa nges 'grel las kyang / rnam par shes pa'i tshogs drug 'di lta ste/ mig gi rnam par shes pa dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de la rnam par shes pa dang bcas pa'i mig dang / gzugs rnams la brten nas mig gi rnam par nges pa 'byung bar 'gyur te/ mig gi rnam par shes pa dang lhan cig gi rjes su 'jug pa/ dus mthun/ spyod yul mthun pa/ rnam par rtog pa'i yid kyi rnam par shes pa 'byung ngo / /blo gros yangs pa de la rnam par shes pa dang bcas pa'i rna ba dang lce dang rnam par shes pa dang bcas pa'i lus dang / reg bya rnams la brten nas lus kyi rnam par shes pa 'byung ba skye bar 'gyur/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa de dang lhan cig tu rjes su 'jug pa dang / dus mthun pa/ spyod yul mthun pa rnam par rtog pa dang bcas pa'i yid kyi rnam par shes pa 'byung ngo / /gal te mig gi rnam par shes pa gcig lan gcig 'byung bar 'gyur na/ rnam par rtog pa'i yid kyi rnam par shes pa mig gi rnam par shes pa dang spyod yul mthun pa gcig kyang lan gcig 'byung ngo / /gal te lan gnyis dang gsum dang / lan gcig rnam par shes pa'i tshogs lnga rnams 'byung bar 'gyur na yang de la rnam par rtog pa'i yid kyi rnam par shes pa/ rnam par shes pa'i tshogs lnga dang spyod yul mthun pa gcig kyang lan cig 'byung ngo zhes gsungs pas don 'di ni dpyad par bya'o/ /gsum par rang rig mngon sum la mtshan nyid/ dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po la dgag pa ni/ chu mig pa rang gi shes pa snang stobs kyis rtog bral ma 'khrul ba zhes pa ni bum 'dzin mngon sum gyis ma nges te/ bum pa'i rnam pa snang ba'i phyir ro/ /kha cig rang gi ngo bo la rtog bral ma 'khrul ba zhes pa ni dbang shes gzung don la rang rig tu thal lo/ /gnyis pa bzhag pa ni/ rang myong byed rtog bral ma 'khrul ba ste/

chos mchog chung bar/ shes pa nyams su myong ba ni yod do/ /shes pa'i ngo bo rig pa de yang bdag nyid kyis mngon sum du byed cing rnam par mi rtog pa dang / ma 'khrul ba de bas na mngon sum yin no zhes so/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ sems sems byung rig pa gnyis las sems kyi mtshan nyid/ don gyi ngo bo tsam rig pa yin la/ sems byung ni don gyi khyad par rig pa ste/ dbus mthar/ de la don mthong rnam par shes/ /de yi khyad par sems las byung / /zhes so/ /gsum pa rnam gzhag ni/ shes pa thams cad kha phyir ltas gzhan rig nang ltas rang rig yin la/ phyi nang gnyis ka dus gcig tu rig pa yin zhing rang rgyu las rab tu gsal bar skyes pas rang rig par bzhag gi/ rang la bya byed gnyis don la yod pas de ltar bzhag pa min te/ rgyan du/ bem min rang bzhin gang yin pa/ /de kho na 'di'i rang rig go /bya dang byed pa'i dbye bas min/ /gcig pa cha med rang bzhin la/ /gsum gyi ngo bo mi 'thad phyir/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa rtsod spang ni/ rtog pa rang rig tu thal lo zhe na/ 'dod de/ rang myong byed yin pas so/ /de'ang rtog pa'ang rang rig nyid du 'dod ces pa mdo las so/ /bzhi pa rnal 'byor mngon sum la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ bdag rkyen/ rig tshul/ rtsod spang / sgrub byed drug gi dang po la dgag pa ni/ kha cig ni bdag rkyen de kho na nyid bsgoms pa la brten nas bdag med pa'i don la rtog bral ma 'khrul ba zhe na/ bdag rkyen de kho na nyid bsgoms pa'i so skye'i dbang shes de rnal 'byor mngon sum du thal ba'i phyir te/ bdag rkyen de kho na bsgoms pa'i skyes bu la brten zhing bdag med pa'i gzung don la mngon sum yin pa'i phyir/ ma nges te/ gser bum 'dzin pa'i dbang shes bum pa la mngon sum du thal/ gser bum la mngon sum yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ 'dod de/ bum 'dzin mngon sum gyi bye brag ma yin par thal ba'i phyir/

'o na/ khyed khegs na bum pa khegs par thal/ bum pa las dngos su skyes pa'i phyir zhe na/ ma nges te/ bum pa khegs na khyod kyis dngos rgyu khegs par thal la/ 'dod na/ bum med kyis phyogs la khyod kyi dngos rgyu khegs par thal lo/ /bzhag pa ni/ bdag rkyen yang dag pa'i don sgom pa'i rab mtha' las byung ba'i rnal 'byor pa'i shes pa rtog bral ma 'khrul ba ste/ rigs thigs las/ yang dag pa'i don bsgoms pa'i rab kyi mtha' las byung ba'i rnal 'byor pa'i shes pa'o zhes so/ /de la yang dag pa'i don ni/ 'og tu 'chad la/ sgom pa ni yang yang du sems la brlan pa dang / rab kyi mtha' ni gsal snang rdzogs pa ste/ 'jig rten chos mchog yin par dul lhas bshad do/ /rnal 'byor ni 'dir mnyam gzhag kho na min gyi sems rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / dngos po'i de kho na nyid rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab kyi mtshan nyid can gyi zhi lhag dang ldan pa yin la/ de bsgom tshul yang bsgom pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i gtos mnyam pa'i rgyu can gyi thos byung gi shes rab kyis nges pa'i don tshad mas sems shing brtags pa blo la bkod cing bzhag nas goms par byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa dbye ba la rten gyis dbye na/ nyan rang / byang sems/ sangs rgyas kyi rnal 'byor mngon sum mo/ /yul gyis phye na ji lta ba dang ji snyed mkhyen pa gnyis so/ /gsum pa bdag rkyen ni/ bden zhing tshad mas 'thad pa'i don 'phags pa'i bden bzhi la sogs pa ste/ rnam 'grel du/ rnal 'byor shes pa sngar bshad pa/ de dag gi ste bsgom byung yin/ /zhes so/ /'di la bden pa bzhi dang rnam pa bcu drug tu dbye ba gnyis las dang po la/ duḥkha/ kun 'byung / 'gog pa/ lam gyi bden pa ste/ de dag gi mtshan nyid kyang rim pa ltar nyer len gyi phung po zag bcas kyi 'bras bur btus pa dang / ma rig pa dang mtshungs ldan gyi srid pa dang / duḥkha zhi bas rab tu phye ba'i zag med kyi chos dang /

'gog bden 'thob pa'i thabs su gyur pa'i bdag med mngon sum du mthong ba'i ye shes te/ rnam 'grel du/ duḥkha 'khor ba can phung po/ /zhes dang / de phyir sred pa srid rten yin/ /zhes dang / duḥkha mi skyed rgyu nyid/ thar yin zhes dang / de yi gnod byed ni/ bdag med mthong ba 'gal ba yin zhes so/ /dbye na duḥkha la/ duḥkha gyi dang / 'gyur ba'i dang / 'du byed kyi duḥkha ste/ tshor ba sdug bden btang snyoms rgyu dang bcas pa'i zhes shākya blos so/ /kun 'byung la 'dod sred/ 'jig sred/ srid sred de rim bzhin bde ba thob par dang / duḥkha bral bar dang / yang srid thob 'dod kyi sred pa'o/ /'gog pa la lhag bcas dang lhag med kyi myang 'das te/ myang 'das gang kun 'byung spangs la duḥkha ma spangs pa dang / myang 'das gang sdug kun gnyis ka spangs pa ste/ shākya blo las/ 'gog pa'i bden pa yang 'dod chags pa spangs pa'o zhes dang / rnam 'grel du/ grol med ma yin sngon 'du byed/ /zad nas gzhan mtshams mi sbyor phyir/ /zhes dang / spangs na'ang srid pa ga la yod/ /ces so/ /yang na theg pa che chung gi myang 'das gnyis so/ /lam la mthong sgom gnyis dngos su gsungs shing mi slob lam yang shugs la gsungs te/ lam dang por ni sred med 'gyur zhes dang / bshad zin lam de goms pa las zhes dang / thabs goms pa zhes dang / shākya blos/ sgom pa'i lam dang mi slob lam las sngar byung ba can nyid yin pa'i phyir mthong ba'i lam/ lam dang po'o zhes so/ /de ltar na lam mtshan nyid pa'i dang po mthong lam yin par gsungs pas/ tshogs sbyor lam mtshan nyid pa yin pa bkag cing / mthong sgom gyi mtshan nyid/ 'jig lta kun btags kho na'i gnyen por gyur pa'i zag med kyi ye shes dang / 'jig lta lhan skyes kyi gnyen por gyur pa'i zag med kyi ye shes te/ 'jig lta kun btags ni phyi rol pa'i bstan bcos legs par sems pa'i sgo nas byung ba'i gzhi med kyi bdag lta ste/

'di rgyun zhugs phyir 'ong phyir mi 'ong gis spangs te/ bden pa mthong tsam gyis spong ba'i phyir ro/ /lhan skyes ni thog med kyi bag chags pa las byung ba'i bdag la sgom spang ste/ 'di 'phags pa snga ma gsum gyis ma spangs so/ mi slob lam gyi mtshan nyid mi slob pa'i lam rnam grol lam las phyis byung gi lam gang gong nas gong du phyin byed de/ mdzod 'grel du/ gong nas gong du phyin par byed pa'i phyir ram phung po'i lhag ma ma lus par 'jug pa'i phyir ro zhes so/ /gnyis pa rnam pa bcu drug tu dbye ba la/ sdug bden gyi rnam pa bzhi ni/ mi rtag duḥkha stong pa/ bdag med bzhi ste/ skye 'jig can dang gzhan dbang can yin pas bdag dang mtshan nyid mi mthun pa dang / bdag gi ba min pas bdag dang bral ba dang / mi rtag gzhan dbang can yin pas bdag gi rang bzhin dang bral ba'i phyir ro/ /kun 'byung ni rgyu kun 'byung rab rkyen gyi rnam pa bzhi ste/ rgyu'i rtsa ba dang / bsdus nas byed pa dang / de kho na duḥkha dang 'brel ba'i rgyu mtshan nyid dang / rang 'dra'i 'bras bu byed pa'i phyir ro/ /'gog bden gyi rnam pa ni 'gog pa/ zhi ba/ gya nom pa/ nges par 'byung ba bzhi ste/ phung po zhig pa'i dang / gdung ba kun zhi ba'i dang / phan pa dang 'dod bya yin pa'i dang / skyo na thams cad bral ba'i phyir ro/ /lam gyi rnam pa ni/ lam/ rim pa/ sgrub pa/ nges par 'byin pa bzhi ste/ 'khor ba las nges par 'byung ba'i thabs dang / rigs pa dang ldan pa dang / yang dag par grub pa dang / shin tu yang dag par 'dren par byed pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'di dag ni rnam 'grel blo gros gnyis dang bcas pa'i lugs yin no/ /bzhi pa rtogs tshul ni/ yul gyi rnam pa mi rtag bdag med sogs ji ltar yod pa bzhin du rtogs pa yin te/ sems kyi rang bzhin dang yang dag pa'i don gyi yul can yin pa'i phyir te/ rnam 'grel du/ yang dag don/

rang bzhin zhes so/ /khyab pa yod/ de nyid du/ rnam shes yul 'dzin pa yi chos/ /ji ltar yod de 'dzin pa dang / /yod pa yi ni bdag nyid de/ /'di yi bskyed par byed pa'ang yin/ /rang bzhin 'di yin zhes pas/ yul yul can gyi chos nyid rang ji ltar yod pa bzhin yul can bskyed pa dang / yul gyi gnas lugs ji lta bar rtogs pa yin zhing / rtag sogs su 'dzin pa ni sems la spang rung gi blo bur dri ma yin pas sems kyi chos nyid min te/ de nyid du/ sems 'di'i rang bzhin 'od gsal te/ dri ma rnams ni blo bur ba/ /zhes so/ /yang / chos can kun rdzob kyi cha rjes thob kyi ye shes dang / chos nyid don dam pa'i cha mnyam gzhag gi yul yin te/ dbus mtha'i 'grel du/ de la mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i shes pa'i yul yin pas kun rdzob kyi bden pa ni rags pa'i de kho na'o/ /de la mnyam par bzhag pa shes pa'i yul yin pas don dam pa'i bden pa ni phra ba'i de kho na'o zhes so/ /lnga pa rtsod spang ni/ ci ste bsgom pa ni rtog pa yang dngos po med pa'i yul can yin na bsgoms pa las rtog med dang / gsal bar snang bar ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ skyon med de/ rtog pas bden bzhi'i dngos po la rnam pa mi rtag sogs su zhen nas bsgoms pas goms bya'i don gsal bar snang ba'i mi rtog pa skye ba mi 'gal te/ las dang lha la sogs pa'i byin rlabs kyis rmi lam bden pa mthong ba bzhin no/ /ci ste/ 'das ma 'ongs kyi yul can gyi rnal 'byor pa'i shes pa yod pa min nam/ ji ltar na gsal bar snang bar 'gyur zhe na/ brtags nas de 'das ma 'ongs kyi yul can du khas blangs kyi don dam par na da lta ba'i yul can yin te/ don dam par ma 'ongs zhig cing ma skyes nas med pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang rnal 'byor pa'i shes pas da lta ba yongs su bcad pa'i rjes su rang bzhin gyi las langs pa na da lta ba 'das ma 'ongs pa'i don phan byed dang phan phyir ngo shes pa'i blo skyes pas 'das ma 'ongs ni 'di lta bu'o zhes rnam par 'jog pa na 'das ma 'ongs kyi don rtog pa med par gsal bar snang ba dang mi slu ba las mngon sum du 'jog go zhes rgyal dbang blo las bshad do/

/drug pa sgrub byed la/ kun mkhyen 'byung rung du bsgrub pa'i rang bzhin gyi rtags ni/ snying rje dang shes rab la sogs pa chos can/ yang yang du goms par byas na tshad med du 'phel du rung ste/ rten brtan goms zin slar bskyed pa lus kyi rtsol ba la mi ltos par sems kyi chos nyid du rang gi ngang gis 'jug pa'i yon tan yin pa'i phyir te/ gtsang sbra can thod pa la skyo ba med pa bzhin no/ /rnam 'grel du/ sems la brtse sogs goms skye ba/ /rang gis ngang gis 'jug 'gyur te/ /zhes dang / ngo bo nyid skyes yon tan yin/ /des na rtsol ba phyi ma dang / /phyi ma khyad par byed pa yin/ /zhes so/ /kun mkhyen byung zin par sgrub pa'i 'bras rtags ni/ thub pa chos can/ de kho na nyid dang / slar mi ldog pa dang / ma lus pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes mnga' ste/ de'i bstan pa gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis la sogs pas bden bzhi ston pa la sogs pa la tshad mas mi slu zhing / snga phyi 'gal ba med la gsung gcig yin pa'i phyir te/ rnam 'grel du/ skyob las de nyid dad brtan dang / /ma lus khyad par mkhyen pa grub/ /ces so/ /gnyis pa phye ba'i dgos pa ni/ chos mchog tu/ gang gi phyir bye brag tu smra ba rnams kyi dbang po nyid lta ba yin pa dang / slob dpon gyi lugs la brten pa'i yid kyi mngon sum bkod pa la gzhan gyi skyon brjod pa dang / kha cig rang rig pa dang rnal 'byor pa'i shes pa khas mi len pa de'i phyir/ log par rtog pa 'di ni thams cad bsal ba'i don du mngon sum rnam pa bzhi rtog pa dang bral zhing ma 'khrul ba'i mtshan nyid dang bcas par bshad ces so/ /gsum pa bsal bya la mtshan nyid ni/ snang yul la 'khrul pa'i shes pa ste/ dbye na tshad ma mdor/ 'khrul dang / kun rdzob yod shes dang / rjes dpag rjes su dpag las byung / /dran dang mngon 'dod ces bya 'o/ /mngon sum ltar snang rab rib bcas/

/zhes pa ltar drug gam/ rtog pa dang rtog med gnyis so/ /dang po drug ni/ smig rgyu la chur 'dzin lta bu'i 'khrul shes dang / spyi 'dzin lta bu kun rdzob la dmigs pa dang / rtags 'dzin dang / rjes dpag dang / dran shes dang / sngon nyams su myong ba'i don thob par 'dod pa dang / dbang yid bslad pa'o/ /yang na rtog pa la/ brda rten can/ don gzhan la sgro 'dogs pa/ lkog tu gyur pa'i don can gsum ste/ dang po ni/ brda la brten nas brda'i yul la 'jug pa'i rtog pa dang / gnyis pa ni/ sngon brda byas pa'i rjes su brda'i rgyu mtshan dang chos mthun par sgro btags nas sngon brda byas pa'i yul la don gzhan la 'jug pa'i rtog pa dang / gsum pa ni/ sngar gyi rtags 'dzin sogs bzhi dang / bzhi pa ni sngar bzhin no/ /bzhi pa tshad 'bras la/ rnam gzhag spyir bstan/ grub mtha'i 'dod lugs/ dgongs pa ngos bzung ba'o/ /dang po la spyir tshad ma'i 'bras bu ni gnyis te/ chod pa dang bcas pa skyes bu'i don dang / chod pa med pa don rtogs pa ste/ dang po ni/ shes pas blang dor gyi don shes nas skyes bus blang dor la nan tan du byed pas mngon du byed pa dang / mi byed pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi 'jug pa thob pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ byed pa gzhan gyis bar ma chod par gzhal bya rtogs pa'i tha snyad 'jog pa ste/ de'i rgyu ni mngon sum yin la 'jog pa po ni rjes kyi nges shes so zhes chos mchog gis bshad do/ /de dag kyang / las/ byed po/ bya ba gsum yin te/ dang po ni gzhal bya/ gnyis pa ni de rtogs pa/ gsum pa ni tshad ma'o/ /des na gzhal bya rtogs pa'i mtshan nyid kyang / gzhal bya dang 'dra bas gzhal bya la mi slu ba'o/ /rtogs tshul la yang snga rabs pa dag dngos rtogs dang shugs rtogs gnyis te/ de'i mtshan nyid kyang / dngos yul dang shugs yul rig pa'o/ /dbye na/ mngon sum dang / rjes dpag gi dngos rtogs dang shugs rtogs gnyis gnyis te/

dang po la yang / gzhan rig mngon sum gyis 'bras bu'i rtags tha dad tha mi dad skye bar dngos su rtogs pas rgyu'i nus pa tha dad tha mi dad yod par shugs la rtogs pa lta bu gzhan rig gis dngos shugs la rtogs pa dang / sngo 'dzin myong ba'i rang rig gi sngo 'dzin de sngon po 'dzin byed du dngos su rtogs pas yul sngon po'i rnam pa shugs la rtogs pa dang / bdag dang gtso bo la rtog pa'i rtog pa myong ba'i rang rig gis rtog pa de bdag dang gtso bo'i rnam pa 'dzin byed du dngos su rtogs pas yul bdag dang gtso bo'i rnam pa shugs la rtogs pa lta bu rang rig gi dngos rtags shugs rtogs gnyis so/ /rjes dpag gi ni/ dper na/ sgra mi rtag par dngos su rtogs pas sgra'i khyad par thams cad mi rtag par shugs las rtogs pa lta bu'o zhe na/ skyu ru ra 'dzin pa'i mig shes chos can/ skyu ru ra'i nus pa shugs la rtogs par thal/ skyu ru ra rtogs pa'i gzhan rig mngon sum yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ skyu ru ra'i nus pa chos can/ gzugs yin par thal/ so so'i mig shes kyis rtogs pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ rig pa yin pa'i phyir te/ chos mchog tu/ gang gi tshe zos pa zhu ba ni/ grang ba dang dro ba la sogs pa byed par nus pa de'i tshe nus pa zhes brjod do zhes so/ /gzhan yang sngon po dang bdag dang gtso bo'i rnam pa de don spyi'am shes pa yin don spyi yin na khyod dngos med du 'dod pas rang rig gis myong byar mi rung la/ shes pa yin na/ dngos su rtogs pa'i phyir shugs la rtogs pa mi 'thad do/ /yang sngo 'dzin dang sngon po'i rnam pa myong ba'i rang rig chos can/ sngo 'dzin dang sngon po la 'di 'dzin pa'o/ /'di gzung ba'o zhes tha dad du 'jog byed yin par thal/ sngo 'dzin de yul sngon po'i rnam pa 'dzin byed du dngos su rtogs pa'i phyir/ 'dod par mi nus te/ chos mchog chung bar/
